Andaman & Nicobar Forest Department Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

Selection will be made through a Physical Endurance Test consisting of three different levels. Candidates participating in Level-I, II & III Tests shall furnish an undertaking that they are physically fit & mentally sound to undertake the test. Candidates failing any test shall not be given a second chance under any circumstances.

Level-I Test (Running Test): Qualifying for short-listing

  • Male: Must complete 10 km
  • Female: Must complete 8 km
  • 15 times the number of vacancies shall be shortlisted.

Level-II Test (Long Jump): Qualifying in nature (to be cleared within three attempts)

Category Male Female
General & OBC 12 feet 9 feet
ST 9 feet 7 feet

Level-III Test (Weight Carrying Test): For final selection/merit

  • Male: Carry 30 kg weight for 500 meters
  • Female: Carry 20 kg weight for 500 meters

Merit list shall be prepared for exact number of vacancies + wait list (maximum 10% of vacancies notified) based on Level-III performance. ST/OBC/EWS candidates selected on merit without relaxed standards will be accommodated against unreserved vacancies. Reserved vacancies will be filled from eligible ST/OBC/EWS domiciled in A&N Islands.

Final selection is subject to verification of certificates, character & antecedents, and medical examination. Selected candidates will undergo 2 years probation.

How to Apply

Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the Andaman Forest Department Mazdoor Recruitment 2026 through the official recruitment portal.

A. Online Application Process

  1. The candidate should register their full particulars of the Application through online only at https://erecruitment.andamannicobar.gov.in
  2. The online application will be accepted from 16/03/2026 (from 11:00 Hrs) to 29/04/2026 (up to 23:59 Hrs).
  3. Candidates should provide all the mandatory details in the online portal. Failing which the application will not be accepted by the website.
  4. Photograph to be uploaded should be:
    • 8-bit JPEG format
    • Size between 10 Kb to 50 Kb
    • Resolution 100 × 200 pixels
  5. It is advised to enable JavaScript in the browser (Internet Explorer, Firefox, Google Chrome, etc.) for successful upload.
  6. The website will allow the applicant to take printout forthwith of the submitted application. Those who fail to take printout immediately can download the filled-in form later also.
  7. All candidates who have registered their name in the local Employment Exchange as unemployed must enter their registration number in the appropriate box while filling the online application.

B. Documents to be submitted at the time of Document Verification (after Physical Test)

Candidates shortlisted after the Physical Test must bring:

  • One copy of recent passport-size photograph
  • Self-attested copies of:
    • Essential Qualification Certificate (10th Pass or ITI in relevant trade)
    • 10th Pass Certificate (showing Date of Birth)
    • OBC/ST/EWS/MSP Certificate (if applicable)
    • Meritorious Sports Person Certificate (if applicable)
    • Employment Registration Certificate/Card (if registered)
    • Printed copy of the Online Application Form

Important Notes from PDF

  • Applications received without the prescribed fee (₹100 for General/OBC/EWS/MSP) shall be summarily rejected.
  • Women candidates and ST candidates are exempted from fee payment.

General Instructions

  • Candidates must read the full notification carefully before applying.
  • Candidature is purely provisional at all stages. Detailed scrutiny of eligibility will be done later.
  • Age is reckoned as on the closing date i.e. 29-04-2026.
  • Candidates must have good physique and meet all physical standards.
  • For Mill Division technical posts (Raftman, Grader, Asst. Sawyer, etc.), a separate Grade-specific Trade Test will be conducted later by DCF, Mill Division, Chatham.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the Physical Test.
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification.
  • The decision of the Department of Environment & Forests, A&N Administration in all matters shall be final and binding.
  • Any dispute shall be subject to the jurisdiction of Courts/Tribunals in A&N Islands only.
  • All updates (Admit Card, Physical Test schedule, Result) will be available only on https://erecruitment.andamannicobar.gov.in.
  • Candidates found using mobile phones or electronic gadgets in the test centre will be disqualified.
  • In case of any difficulty, contact Helpline: 03192-255228 (10:00 AM to 5:00 PM on working days).

The selection for Andaman & Nicobar ANM Recruitment 2026 will be based on the following:

Computer Based Test (CBT): The selection will be done by conducting Computer Based Test. The CBT will consist of 80% Professional/technical subject related questions, 10% General Awareness and 10% General Science. There will be negative marking of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer.

Document Verification: All successful candidates shortlisted through the CBT will be called for Document/Certificate verification in person. Final selection will be made on the basis of merit in the CBT subject to verification of all mandatory original certificates/testimonials.

Proof of age, Educational qualification certificates, Category certificate (ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD/MSP as applicable), NOC (for Central Govt./Departmental candidates), Recent passport size photograph and Signature.

Eligible female candidates for Andaman & Nicobar ANM Recruitment 2026 must submit their application online through the official portal https://erecruitment.andamannicobar.gov.in within the specified last date. The online application process is as follows:

Step 1 - Registration & Filling Details: Visit the portal https://erecruitment.andamannicobar.gov.in from 16 April 2026 (11:00 AM) onwards. Fill Personal details, Educational Qualification details, Post Details and Payment details.

Step 2 - Upload Documents: Upload scanned copies of proof of age, educational qualification, category certificate, NOC (if applicable), Photograph and Signature as per specifications.

Step 3 - Final Submission & Fee Payment: Pay the applicable fee (if any) online. Submit the application. Only complete applications with all five sections filled and documents uploaded will be accepted.

Note: No physical copy of application shall be entertained. Candidates are advised to read the instructions carefully before submitting the online application. Once submitted, the application cannot be modified. Candidates must satisfy themselves that they fulfil all eligibility conditions to avoid rejection of candidature.

APPSC TGT Eligibility Criteria 2026

Candidates who wish to apply for APPSC Trained Graduate Teacher Recruitment 2026 must carefully check the APPSC TGT Eligibility Criteria 2026 in terms of nationality, age limit and educational qualification. Only those applicants who fully meet the APPSC TGT eligibility conditions as on the last date of application will be considered for the Trained Graduate Teacher Examination 2026.

APPSC TGT Age Limit 2026

  • Minimum Age: 21 years
  • Maximum Age: 35 years as on 27th April 2026 (last date for receipt of online application)
  • Upper age limit is relaxable for APST, PwBD and other categories as per Government of Arunachal Pradesh rules and latest orders.

APPSC TGT Educational Qualification 2026

  • Candidates must possess a Second‑Class Bachelor’s Degree in Arts, Science or Commerce from a recognised university.
  • The applicant must have studied the concerned subject in all years/semesters of the Bachelor’s Degree programme, and the final year/semester marksheet must clearly show the subject name and marks.
  • A B.Ed (General) degree from an NCTE recognised institute is mandatory; only General B.Ed is acceptable for teaching Classes IX–X as per the Education Department instructions.
  • B.Ed (Special Education) is not treated as an alternative professional qualification for APPSC TGT (Secondary) posts.
  • The minimum duration of the B.Ed programme should be two years including mandatory school internship; however, one‑year B.Ed degrees obtained before 2015 are also considered eligible.
  • Candidates who have completed a Four‑Year Integrated Degree Programme with B.Ed (General) are eligible, provided they meet the subject‑specific requirements.
  • Students who are still in the final year/final semester of Bachelor’s Degree or B.Ed are not eligible to apply for APPSC TGT 2026.
  • Each candidate is allowed to apply for only one TGT (Secondary) post/subject under this recruitment.

Only Indian citizens fulfilling the above APPSC TGT Eligibility Criteria 2026 in terms of age, essential educational qualification and professional B.Ed degree should submit the APPSC TGT online application form on appsc.gov.in.

APPSC TGT Salary 2026

The candidates selected under APPSC Trained Graduate Teacher Recruitment 2026 will receive a salary in Pay Matrix Level‑7, which corresponds to a basic pay scale of ₹44,900 to ₹1,42,400 per month for the TGT post in the Education Department, Government of Arunachal Pradesh. In addition to the APPSC TGT basic pay 2026, selected teachers will be entitled to various allowances as per state government norms, such as Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance (HRA), and other admissible benefits under Group‑B (Non‑Gazetted) cadre, making the overall APPSC Trained Graduate Teacher salary package attractive for eligible graduates with B.Ed.

APPSC TGT Selection Process 2026

The APPSC Trained Graduate Teacher Recruitment 2026 selection process is conducted in two main stages – a Written Examination (Objective) followed by Viva‑Voce and Classroom Teaching. Candidates must qualify the APPSC TGT Written Exam 2026 by securing the prescribed minimum marks to be shortlisted for the APPSC TGT Viva‑Voce round.

Stage 1 – APPSC TGT Written Examination 2026

  • The APPSC TGT Written Examination (Objective) consists of two parts – a General paper and a Concerned Subject paper, together carrying a total of 450 marks.
  • Paper 1 – General English, General Studies, Aptitude & Pedagogy (Objective): 150 marks.
  • Paper 2 – Concerned Subject (Objective): 300 marks in the relevant TGT subject (e.g. English, Hindi, Mathematics, Science, Social Science, etc.).
  • There is negative marking in the APPSC TGT exam – 1/6th of the marks allotted to the question will be deducted for each wrong answer.
  • To qualify the written exam, a candidate must secure at least the minimum qualifying marks prescribed in the notification (overall aggregate as well as subject‑wise), only then they will be considered for the next stage of the APPSC TGT selection process 2026.

Stage 2 – APPSC TGT Viva‑Voce & Classroom Teaching 2026

  • Candidates who qualify in the written examination will be shortlisted in order of merit in a ratio of about 3 times the number of advertised TGT vacancies for the Viva‑Voce and Classroom Teaching test.
  • The APPSC TGT Viva‑Voce and Classroom Teaching carries 50 marks and is conducted on the premises of the Arunachal Pradesh Public Service Commission.
  • This stage evaluates the candidate’s subject knowledge, teaching skills, communication ability, classroom handling and overall suitability for the Trained Graduate Teacher post.

Final Merit List – APPSC Trained Graduate Teacher 2026

  • The final selection for APPSC Trained Graduate Teacher Recruitment 2026 is made on the basis of total marks obtained out of 500 marks (450 marks in Written Examination + 50 marks in Viva‑Voce & Classroom Teaching).
  • Candidates who fail to meet the minimum qualifying marks in the written exam or are found ineligible at document verification will not be considered for final appointment as APPSC TGT, even if they appeared in the examination.

How to Apply for APPSC TGT Recruitment 2026

The application process for APPSC Trained Graduate Teacher Recruitment 2026 is completely online. Eligible candidates must first complete One Time Registration (OTR) on the APPSC portal and then submit the APPSC TGT Application Form 2026 within the specified dates.

  • Step 1: Visit the official website of Arunachal Pradesh Public Service Commission at www.appsc.gov.in.
  • Step 2: Click on the “One Time Registration (OTR)” link and complete the registration by entering basic details to generate your Login ID and password (if already registered, skip this step and log in directly).
  • Step 3: After successful OTR, log in with your registered User ID and password and open the online application link for Advertisement No. 02/2026 – Trained Graduate Teacher Examination 2026 (Secondary Level).
  • Step 4: Fill in the APPSC TGT online application form with accurate personal details, contact information, TGT subject/post, category, educational qualifications and B.Ed details as per your certificates.
  • Step 5: Upload scanned copies of your recent passport‑size photograph, signature and required documents (photo ID, APST certificate, PwBD certificate, etc.) in the prescribed format and file size.
  • Step 6: Pay the APPSC TGT application fee 2026 online – ₹150 for APST candidates and ₹200 for other candidates, while PwBD candidates are exempted from fee payment.
  • Step 7: Carefully review all details entered in the APPSC TGT Application Form 2026; submit only a single, fully completed application. In case of multiple forms, the one with the highest Registration ID and complete details will be considered.
  • Step 8: Click on “Submit” to finalise the form and download/print the submitted APPSC TGT application form and fee receipt for future reference, written examination and document verification.

Applicants are advised to complete the APPSC TGT online form 2026 well before the last date to avoid last‑minute technical issues and ensure successful submission.

  • Medical qualification included in Part-I or Part-III of the Schedule to the Dentist Act, 1948 as amended from time to time.
  • Post-Graduate Degree in the concerned specialty mentioned in Section 'A', 'B', or 'D' as the case may be in Schedule-VI or equivalent of Arunachal Pradesh Health Service Rules, 2000.
  • The candidate (including Foreign Medical Graduates/Post Graduates) must be registered with Arunachal Pradesh Dental Council (APDC).

One Time Relaxation (GoAP): The Government of Arunachal Pradesh has granted One Time Relaxation vide GoAP Notification No. DMETR-11012(17)/1/2024 dated 7th February 2026, waiving off the requirement of 3 years' experience after Post Graduate Degree and 5 years' experience after Post Graduate Diploma in the concerned Speciality.

Age Limit

Candidates must not exceed 50 years as on the last date of submission of online application form (18th May 2026), in accordance with One Time Relaxation vide GoAP Notification No. DMETR-11012(17)/1/2024 dated 7th February 2026. Age relaxation of 5 years is available for Government Servants. Age concession for PwBD candidates and regular Govt. servants of Government of Arunachal Pradesh will be as per Government rules in force.

APPSC Medical Specialist Recruitment 2026 – Application Fee

Category Application Fee
APST Candidates ₹ 150/-
Other Candidates (General/UR) ₹ 200/-
PwBD Candidates NIL

PwBD candidates are exempted from payment of application fee as per Section 19 of the Arunachal Pradesh Rights of Persons with Disabilities Rules, 2018.

APPSC Medical Specialist Recruitment 2026 – Selection Process

Selection will be made through Viva-Voce / Interview only in accordance with the Arunachal Pradesh Health Service Rules-2000 amended vide Notification No. HFW-1/89(Pt) dated 31/10/2003. The total marks of Interview shall be 100 marks.

  • Candidates must score a minimum of 50% of the total marks in the interview to qualify for selection (as per Rule XI, Sub-rule (e) of APPSC Manual for Conduct of Examination-2024).
  • Relaxation for PwBD candidates, if any, shall apply as per the Government notification.
  • Candidates will be shortlisted for interview based on information provided in the online application form.
  • Eligible candidates must produce all original certificates/documents/mark sheets at the time of interview. If a candidate is found ineligible during document verification, candidature shall be rejected.
  • The date for interview of eligible candidates will be notified in due course.

Documents to Be Uploaded with Online Application

  • Signature of the candidate on white paper with black ink pen (40–50 kb, jpg format).
  • Latest/recent colour passport-size photo (40–100 kb, jpg format) — white background, front-faced, without headgear or sunglasses.
  • Self-attested photocopy of Matriculation Certificate/Marksheet with Date of Birth (only document accepted as proof of DOB).
  • Self-attested photocopy of APST certificate (for APST candidates seeking reservation).
  • Self-attested photocopy of Aadhaar Card / PRC / EPIC as identity proof (for non-APST applicants).
  • Self-attested photocopy of Bachelor Degree certificates and mark sheets issued by the University.
  • Self-attested photocopy of Master Degree certificates and mark sheets issued by the University.
  • Experience Certificate in the concerned speciality, if any.
  • PwBD/PwD disability certificate issued by certifying authority as per Section 57 of Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 — must clearly mention the Percentage of Disability and must be issued before the last date of application submission.
  • Self-attested photocopy of APMC Registration Certificate (for Allopathy) or APDC Registration Certificate (for Dental).
  • Govt. employees: Copy of intimation submitted to Head of Department or NOC issued by the department.

How to Apply for APPSC Medical Specialist Recruitment 2026

Applications must be submitted online only at https://appsc.gov.in. One Time Registration (OTR) is mandatory before filling the application form.

Apply Online – appsc.gov.in

1. Complete One Time Registration (OTR): Visit https://appsc.gov.in and mandatorily register for OTR before filling the online application form. Candidates who have already registered in OTR can directly log in with the same user ID and password.

2. Fill the Online Application Form: The online application link will be active from 17th April 2026 (1700 hrs) to 18th May 2026 (1700 hrs). Fill all details carefully and accurately. The application form once submitted within the last date shall be complete in all respects — no additional time will be provided for further changes.

3. Upload Required Documents: Upload scanned copies of all required documents (as listed in Point E of the notification) in the prescribed format and file size. Ensure all uploads are clear and self-attested.

4. Pay Application Fee: Pay the applicable fee — ₹150/- for APST candidates, ₹200/- for others. PwBD candidates are exempted. Fee payment is through the online mode on the APPSC portal.

5. Submit Application: Read the DISCLAIMER provided in the online application form carefully before final submission. If multiple applications are submitted, the one with the highest Registration ID (RID) will be accepted. Ensure the highest RID application is complete in all respects.

6. Govt. Service Applicants: Candidates in Government Service must upload a copy of intimation submitted to their respective Head of Department or an NOC issued by the department along with the application form.

  • For the Resource Person (Assistant in Programme Production/Management) post, candidates should have passed Class XII with at least 3 years’ experience in TV or Doordarshan programme production and coordination, or be graduates with a professional diploma in TV Programme Production, Mass Communication or Journalism. DD Guwahati Casual Assignee Selection Process 2026

  • The written or skill tests can be conducted in various formats such as objective (multiple choice), descriptive, computer‑based tests, group discussions, one‑on‑one interviews, or software‑based practical tests (for example, video editing or graphics software proficiency).
  • These tests and interactions will assess the candidate’s skills, suitability, efficiency and personality for the specific casual assignee category (Resource Person, Video Assistant, Video Editor, Website/Social Media, Camera Assistant, CG Operator, Library/Archive Assistant).

  • After the completion of assessments, a panel (empanelment list) of suitable candidates will be prepared for each category; inclusion in the panel does not guarantee regular employment and engagement will be purely on assignment basis.

Selection Process

Selection will be made through Computer Based Test (CBT) only.

  • The CBT will comprise of objective type questions with multiple choice of answers. The Question Paper and instructions will be Bilingual (English/Hindi). However, in case of any error in Hindi version, the English version of the question shall be valid & final.
  • The CBT will consist of two sections (Section – ‘A’ & Section – ‘B’):
    • Section – ‘A’: Questions related to Technical Knowledge (Discipline related) with 80 Multiple Choice Questions (MCQ).
    • Section – ‘B’: Questions related to General Awareness/Aptitude and Knowledge of CIL/SECL with 20 multiple choice questions (MCQ).
  • Each question will carry 1 mark and there is no penalty for wrong answer. No marks will be awarded for un-attempted questions.
  • Syllabus for the Computer Based Test (CBT) is attached as Annexure-A in the notification.
  • Selection of candidates in merit panel will be subject to securing of cut-off marks (Minimum Qualifying marks) in the Computer Based Test for concerned post with respect to their category as mentioned below and fulfilling prescribed eligibility criteria:
Category Qualifying marks in CBT
For General/EWS Candidates 45 marks
For OBC(NCL)/ESM Candidates 40 marks
For SC/ST Candidates 35 marks
  • Result of the Computer Based Test (CBT) will be published on SECL website as early as possible after successful completion of the CBT.
  • Provisional merit panels of candidates who secure the requisite cut-off marks and above and fulfilling the eligibility criteria will be published, in the order of marks scored, after resolving tie.
  • In case of tie of marks between 02 or more candidates, the merit-list will be prepared as per the following criteria: a) Date of Birth (As per the descending order of age of candidates) b) Seniority as per the Date of issue of Statutory Certificate c) In case still tied up, alphabetical order of the name of the candidates as recorded in the application form may be taken into consideration. d) In case still tied-up, the Selection Committee will decide the criteria for deciding the merit position of tied candidates.
  • Final merit panel will be prepared based on the marks obtained in the Computer Based Test.
  • Such candidates who would score equal or above the cut off (Minimum qualifying marks as provided in Table D) and as per vacancy available in each category, would only be notified for appearing for scrutiny/ verification of their testimonials supporting their claim of candidature, in order of their respective merit position drawn on the basis of marks scored in Computer Based Test (CBT) for different positions up to the extent the positions remain unfilled. The candidates shall have to appear along with all original certificates/ documents as per eligibility criteria notified in this Employment Notification for scrutiny/ verification. The date, time and venue for scrutiny/ verification shall be notified on SECL website and the candidates shall have to report accordingly. In the event of failure to report with all original certificates and testimonials within the stipulated time, the candidature of such candidate should stand cancelled.
  • Provisional Appointment Letter will be issued to the successful candidates in accordance with their relative merit position and with due consideration of the reservation of posts to the reserved category candidates and against vacancies.
  • If it is found during the Scrutiny/ Verification, or during the course of training, or even during the course of employment, that the candidate is not fulfilling the eligibility criteria in any respect, suppressing of facts or false declaration pertaining to his Employment/Caste/ Testimonials etc. then his/her candidature/ employment will be cancelled/terminated.

Note: In case, a candidate, selected for a particular post & declared as UNFIT during Initial Medical Examination, the case would be referred to Apex Medical Board of the Company within one month based on the written/physical representation and the decision of the Apex Medical Board will be final. If the Candidate is declared UNFIT by the Apex Medical Board, his/ her selection shall stand automatically cancelled. Such candidates will be communicated the decision of the Apex Medical Board as well as regarding cancellation of their selection.

2. How to Apply

Application Mode: Online only through SECL website. No other mode (post, email, offline) will be accepted.

Steps to Apply:

  1. Visit the official website of SECL https://secl-cil.in/ → Career → Employment Notification for Direct Recruitment of various Statutory posts → Apply online.
  2. Employment Notification is available in both English and Hindi. Candidates may select either of them at their convenience.
  3. While applying online, candidate needs to upload the scanned copies of:
    • Recent passport size colour photograph (not older than 3 weeks in jpg/jpeg format)
    • Signature with Black ink pen (in jpg/jpeg format)
    • Matriculation certificate or equivalent examination certificate or Degree or Diploma Certificate for the post of Mining Sirdar & Dy. Surveyor (in jpg/jpeg/PDF format)
    • Matriculate or equivalent examination passed from any recognized Board of examination & Diploma or relevant and higher qualification (Minimum 3 years course) in Electrical Engineering from any Institute recognized by the Government, for the post of Assistant Foreman (Electrical) (in jpg/jpeg/PDF format)
    • Valid Caste Certificate OBC (NCL)/SC/ST candidates and Income Certificate for EWS Candidates (if applicable) (in jpg/jpeg/PDF format)
    • Ex-Servicemen Certificates (if applicable) (in jpg/jpeg/PDF format)
    • PwBD Certificates (if applicable) (in jpg/jpeg/PDF format)
    • Competency certificate of Mining Sirdar/Surveyor (in jpg/jpeg/PDF format)
    • Gas Testing & First Aid Certificate (for Mining Sirdar only) (in jpg/jpeg/PDF format)
  4. Register by filling up necessary details (Post opted, name, Mobile No. and e-mail ID and click on Submit Button).
  5. Check the User ID and password received on your e-mail and mobile number after successful registration.
  6. Re-login to your account entering the User ID and Password received on Mobile No. and e-mail ID.
  7. Click on the option to go to application form and fill all the necessary details in the respective fields and upload all the required documents including Photograph and Signature.
  8. Check Preview of the Application Form and make corrections, if any.
  9. Press Submit Button and make Online Payment of the fees through Debit Card/Credit Card/Net Banking (as applicable).
  10. Keep the print out of the online application form filled for future references.

Application Fee:

Category Amount (₹)
Unreserved (UR) /OBC- (Creamy Layer & Non-Creamy Layer) / EWS ₹1000/- + GST ₹180/- = ₹1180/-
SC/ ST/ESM/PwBD/ Departmental Candidates/Female Candidates Nil

Note: Applications without the prescribed fee will not be entertained and summarily rejected. No representation against such rejection would be entertained. Fee once paid shall neither be refunded nor be adjusted under any circumstances. Any tax or Bank charges other than the application fees will be borne by the candidates. Application fee will be paid through online mode only.

General Instructions

  • Application should be submitted through ONLINE Mode only.
  • All qualifications should be recognized by AICTE / UGC / appropriate Indian Statutory Authorities.
  • Before submitting the application, the candidate must ensure that he/ she fulfills all the eligibility criteria and other norms mentioned in the Employment Notification. He/ she may cross check the information such as Date of Birth, Category, Contact Details, and Qualifications etc. furnished in the application form before finally submitting the same online as no correction would be possible later and no correspondence will be considered in this regard.
  • The decision of SECL management regarding eligibility criteria, acceptance or rejection of applications, penalty for false information, mode of selection, selection and posting of selected candidates, will be final and binding on the candidates and no enquiry/correspondence will be entertained in this regard.
  • Mere issuance of Admit Card/ Call Letter to a candidate will not imply that his/ her candidature has been finally cleared by SECL. The candidature shall remain provisional till such time SECL verifies the eligibility conditions with reference to original documents after the candidate qualifies in the CBT and confirms appointment.
  • Candidates should ensure that they fulfill the eligibility criteria prescribed for the post for which they have applied. In case it is found at any stage of the selection process or even after the appointment that the candidate has submitted false or incorrect information or suppressed any relevant information/ material facts or does not fulfill the eligibility criteria, his/her candidature/ service is liable for rejection/ termination without notice.
  • No relaxation in the minimum educational qualification, as prescribed in Clause - '2' of this Employment Notification, is admissible for any category of candidate.
  • Wherever Grade (CGPA/ OGP/ DGPA etc.) is awarded, a certificate duly issued by concerned Board/University for conversion of Grade to percentage is to be produced by the candidate at the time of Scrutiny/ Verification of Original documents.
  • Age and all other eligibility criteria shall be reckoned as on the cut-off date as prescribed under this Employment Notification.
  • Candidates should carefully fill up their category (General/ SC/ ST/ OBC- Non Creamy Layer/ Ex-Servicemen/ EWS/PwBD etc.) in the Online Application Form. No change of category shall be allowed at the later stage of selection process.
  • Ex-servicemen must produce discharge certificate issued by Army/Navy/ Air Force of Indian Union at the time of document verification.
  • All documents (Caste Certificate, Educational Qualifications, EWS certificate, etc.) as per applicability and as provided by the candidate will be verified from the office of issuing authority and candidature will be cancelled if the certificates are not found satisfactory/ genuine at any subsequent stage of Computer Based Test (CBT).
  • The candidates must have an active E-mail Id & Mobile number which must remain valid for at least next one year. All correspondences with the candidates shall be done either through Speed Post/ Registered e-mail id & Mobile number (as may be necessary) and all general information shall be provided through SECL website. However, admit card will be provided only through SECL website and the candidates will have to download the admit card. The responsibilities of receiving, downloading and printing of application form, admit card and other information shall be of candidates. SECL will not be responsible for any loss of document due to invalid/ wrong/ incomplete contact details provided by the candidate or for delay/ non-receipt of information. In case of any problems faced by the candidates in filling up the online application they may refer the "Help Desk Option" available in the individual login portal. For queries other than the Online Application Form, candidates may write to Email Id: [email protected] only or can call us on 9425598240.
  • Candidates are advised to apply much before the closing date for submission of Online Application mentioned in this Employment Notification to avoid last minute network congestion.
  • SECL will not take any responsibility for the candidates not being able to submit their applications Online within the prescribed closing dates on account of any reasons beyond the control of SECL.
  • SECL reserves the right to shortlist candidates for Computer Based Test, reschedule the test date & venue etc. or alter any of the advertised condition depending upon the circumstances.
  • SECL will not bear any liability on account of service bond/ salary/ leave salary/ pension contribution, etc, if any, of previous employment of any candidate already working in Central Govt./ State Govt./ Autonomous Body/ Public Sector Undertaking.
  • Candidates employed in Govt./ Semi Govt./ Public Sector Undertaking (including departmental candidates) / Autonomous Bodies are required to produce 'No Objection Certificate' at the time of Scrutiny /Verification of original documents if shortlisted.
  • Selected candidates could be posted in any of the Mines/Establishments of SECL and are liable to be transferred to other subsidiaries of Coal India Limited any time during their service as may be required.
  • Appointment of selected candidates will be subject to being found medically fit in the Company's Medical Examination as per the laid down Rules related to Medical Examination of CIL.
  • Selection of candidate shall be provisional, subject to verification of documents relating to eligibility criteria, character, antecedents and other documents submitted by the candidate and is also subject to his/ her meeting other requirements applicable for appointment under the rules of SECL.
  • Appointment of the candidate in SECL will be subject to verification of Character & Antecedents by the prescribed authorities and if any discrepancy / suppression is found, the candidature of the candidate will be cancelled and decision of SECL in this regard shall be final.
  • The date of Computer Based Test (CBT) and other details will be subsequently informed. Candidates will have to appear at the Centre/ Venue allotted to them by SECL for the Computer Based Test (CBT). No change in Centre/ Venue is permissible and no application shall be entertained in this regard.
  • SC/ ST candidates called for Computer Based Test (CBT) will be paid up to IInd Class Non-AC fare as per rules. However they have to submit their claims in duly filled appropriate TA Claim format provided at the examination centre along with all desired enclosures like caste certificate, photocopy of Onward (mandatory) and return Journey (optional) of railway ticket / bus receipt ticket to the room invigilator after attempting Computer Based Test (CBT) only, subsequent claims as well as claims with incomplete information will not be entertained. The distance of examination centre will be calculated from the Permanent address of the candidate or from place of actual journey whichever is shorter. In case, candidate has submitted only onward journey ticket and not submitted return journey tickets then the claims will be considered up to the double of onward journey fare and that will be paid as per rule.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the CBT, scrutiny/ verification of certificates and documents or for joining on being selected except otherwise as provided in this Employment Notification.
  • Candidate will appear for the CBT at the exam center at his/her owns risk and South Eastern Coalfields Limited will not be responsible for any injury or losses etc.
  • SECL management reserves the right to modify/ alter/ restrict/ enlarge/ cancel the recruitment process, and revise the number of vacancies, at its discretion without assigning any reasons whatsoever. The decision of the SECL management will be final and no appeal will be entertained in this regard.
  • All future communication/ information regarding this recruitment will be made available on SECL website. Candidates are advised to check/ visit SECL website regularly for further updates.
  • Court of Jurisdiction for any dispute will be Honorable High Court of Chhattisgarh, Bilaspur.
  • In case of any ambiguity/ confusion, English Version of Employment Notification will be considered valid.
  • Canvassing in any form will be treated as dis-qualification.
  • At the time of Computer Based Test (CBT), if a candidate is found guilty of using unfair means or impersonating or misbehaving in the examination hall or resorting to any other unfair means in connection with his/her candidature for the selection; or obtaining support of his/ her candidature by any means, such candidates will be liable to criminal prosecution and will be disqualified from the Computer Based Test (CBT). The Company may also debar such candidates from participating in any selection process in the Company in future.
  • If it is detected that any candidate has furnished any false information / particulars with regard to his/ her qualification, Category/caste and experience in the Application Form or in any document and/ or misrepresented / suppressed any material fact in the application form, for securing appointment, his/ her service will be terminated forthwith during probation period or even after confirmation of the service.
  • The Candidates whose postings are finalized after CBT, Verification and IME will be disqualified if they put external pressure for place of posting.

Chhattisgarh High Court DEO Vacancy 2026

A total of 38 vacancies have been announced for the post of Data Entry Operator (DEO) at the Chhattisgarh High Court, Bilaspur. The vacancies are distributed across four categories - Unreserved (UR), Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST), and Other Backward Classes (OBC) - with separate reservation for women candidates within each category. S. No. Category No. of Posts Post Reserved (PwD)

Chhattisgarh High Court DEO Eligibility Criteria 2026

Before applying for Chhattisgarh High Court DEO Recruitment 2026, candidates must ensure they satisfy all the prescribed eligibility conditions. The candidate must be a citizen of India. Working knowledge of Unix/Open Source Software/Windows NT is required along with the following educational qualifications.

The primary educational qualification is at least a second class Bachelor's Degree from a recognised University in Computer Science or a related subject; OR a second class Bachelor's Degree from any recognised University with PGDCA from any recognised University; OR a second class Bachelor's Degree from a recognised University with 'O' level course from DOE (Department of Electronics).

Nationality Citizen of India
Educational Qualification Second class Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related subject from a recognised University; OR Second class Bachelor's Degree with PGDCA from any recognised University; OR Second class Bachelor's Degree with 'O' level course from DOE
Technical Knowledge Working knowledge of Unix/Open Source Software/Windows NT
Desirable Experience Working knowledge of Operating Systems and Office application suites
Typing Knowledge Knowledge of Hindi and English typing (Preference to candidates who have passed typewriting examination in Hindi and English from any recognised board)
Other Conditions Good character, sound mind and body; not more than one spouse living; not dismissed from service by any High Court/Government/Statutory/Local Authority; not convicted of any offence involving moral turpitude

Chhattisgarh High Court DEO Age Limit 2026

The age limit for Chhattisgarh High Court DEO Recruitment 2026 is calculated as on 01.01.2026. The minimum age is 21 years and the maximum age is 30 years for general/non-Chhattisgarh resident candidates. For bonafide residents of Chhattisgarh, the maximum age limit is 40 years.

All fee payment must be done through the prescribed online mode on the Vyapam portal only. No TA/DA will be admissible to any candidate for appearing in any of the tests conducted as part of the selection process.

Selected candidates appointed to the post of Data Entry Operator (DEO) at the Chhattisgarh High Court, Bilaspur will be entitled to pay as per Level-6 of the Chhattisgarh Government Pay Matrix. In addition to the basic pay, candidates will be entitled to all other allowances and benefits as per the rules applicable to State Government employees. Selected candidates after their joining will be kept on probation for the period as mentioned in the applicable rules.

Post Pay Level Pay Range (₹)
Data Entry Operator (DEO) Level-6 of Pay Matrix ₹25,300 – ₹80,500

Chhattisgarh High Court DEO Selection Process 2026

The selection process for Chhattisgarh High Court DEO Recruitment 2026 consists of two phases - Phase I Written Test and Phase II Skill Test. The examination is conducted through the Chhattisgarh Vyapam portal. Phase I Written Test is only a screening test; the merit list will be prepared exclusively on the basis of marks obtained in Phase II Skill Test, and the marks obtained in Phase I Written Test will not be considered for the preparation of the Merit List/Select List.

Candidates will be called for Phase II Skill Test in the ratio of 1:15 based on marks obtained in the Written Test. After receipt of the merit list (category wise - SC, ST, OBC, Male, Female and Divyang separately, and common merit list) from Vyapam, the High Court will publish the same on its website and document verification will be conducted at the High Court. After document verification, the select list and waiting list will be published on the official website of the Chhattisgarh High Court. In case of tie in marks in the Skill Test, the candidate born earlier will be placed above. If date of birth is also the same, preference will be given to candidates who have passed the Typewriting examination in Hindi and English from any recognised board.

Phase I - Written Test (100 Marks)

The Written Test consists of 100 Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) divided into two sections. There shall be no negative marking in Phase I.

Section I: 60 Marks
Reasoning Quantitative Aptitude English General Studies & General Knowledge

Selection Process

There will be no interviews.

The eligible candidates will be shortlisted on the basis of merit list formed on the basis of marks secured in Matriculation examination (10th), 12th and ITI Course / Diploma and Bachelor of Engineering or MBA as per following details:

Apprentices Weightage Total marks
Graduate Apprentice 20% to 10th 20% to 12th / Diploma (whichever is higher, in case of both) 60% to aggregate in Engineering/MBA 100
Diploma Apprentice 30% to 10th 70% to Diploma in Engineering 100
ITI Apprentice 30% to 10th 70% to ITI 100

In case of a tie in total marks between two candidates, the one older in age will be considered senior for further selection process.

The candidates shortlisted on the basis of the information provided in the Application Form shall have to produce all original testimonials/certificates at the time of verification. In case any information/claim made by the applicant in his/her application is found to be false, the candidature of such applicant shall be cancelled and he/she shall be liable for prosecution.

Also, the candidate will have to produce a certificate of medical fitness before joining.

The selection and deployment of Apprentice Trainees will be subject to detailed provisions of Apprenticeship Act. The contracts with candidates thus selected will be registered under Board of Apprentice Training (BOAT)/ National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS) Portal.

How to Apply

Eligible and interested candidates would be required to apply online only through the Career section on SJVN’s website: www.sjvn.nic.in. No other means/mode of application shall be accepted.

Before registering their applications on the website, the candidates should possess the following:

a) Valid e-mail ID and mobile number, which should remain valid for at least one year.

b) Personal details and educational qualification details and a Debit card/ Credit card/ Internet banking detail via which the payment of application fee of Rs. 100/- (SC/ST/PwD exempted) is to be made on e-recruitment portal. Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstance.

c) Candidates should have scanned copy of latest passport size photograph, as well as photograph of signatures in digital format (.jpg or .jpeg file only, less than 500 KB size) for uploading with the application form.

d) Candidates should clearly note that SJVN, in any case, will not be responsible for rejection of application on account of application being incomplete, non-submission of application or payment or any delay in receipt thereof on any account whatsoever.

General Instructions

  • Age Limit: The minimum age limit is 18 years and the maximum will be 30 Years as on closing date. Concession & Relaxation: a) Upper age is relaxed by 5 years for SC/ST candidates and 3 years for OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates. b) Candidates belonging to PwD categories shall be given age relaxation up to 10 years (up to 15 years for SC/ST and up to 13 years for OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates.
  • Stipend: i. Graduate Apprentices: ₹10,000/- Per Month ii. Diploma Apprentices: ₹8,000/- Per Month iii. ITI Apprentices: ₹7,000/- Per Month.
  • Training duration: One Year.
  • Reservation: Reservation of seats for SC/ST/OBC (NCL) and PWDs will be as per the provisions of the Apprenticeship Act, 1961 and its amendments thereafter.
  • Preference to PAF/PAA: 25% seats are earmarked for candidates from Project Affected Families (PAF) and Project Affected Areas (PAA) of STPL with first preference to members of Project Affected Families. However, the candidates will have to produce a certificate in this regard issued from the Competent Authority/Revenue Department/ Panchayat and duly verified by concerned SJVN offices.
  • Only Candidates who are domicile of Bihar State are eligible to apply.
  • Candidates should apply for only one trade / discipline for which he/ she is most desirous, based on his/her qualification. In case of multiple applications from a candidate, the latest one shall be considered as final and older application shall be rejected.
  • Candidates should be eligible with respect to age criteria and educational qualification as on closing date of advertisement. Result awaited candidates need not apply. Candidates who have undergone apprenticeship training in SJVN/ STPL need not apply.
  • Employment in SJVN/ STPL: No extension of training and employment will be given after the completion of one-year training by SJVN/ STPL.
  • Candidates will have to make their own stay and transportation arrangements.
  • The candidates who after the completion of their education have undergone training or job experience of one year or more shall not be considered eligible for apprenticeship training. Even if the gap between the declaration of result and the commencement of training is more than five years, the candidate will be declared not eligible.
  • All correspondence with the registered candidates regarding issuance of call letter/offer of apprenticeship training etc. shall be done through their registered email and/or mobile phones only. The candidates are required to keep their registered email and mobile phone active for at least one year from the date of registration.
  • All information regarding lists of candidates shortlisted for further selection process & list of candidates finally selected shall be made available on website of SJVN www.sjvn.nic.in. Candidates can download relevant lists etc. from the site. Call letters shall be emailed to candidates at their registered email IDs. No separate call letters shall be sent to the candidates by post. SJVN will not be responsible for any loss of e-mail/ SMS sent due to invalid or wrong email ID/mobile phone no. or delivery of emails to spam/bulk mail folder.
  • The sole responsibility of downloading or uploading of documents on SJVN website / SJVN portal and downloading / printing of call letters shall be that of the candidate.
  • Any corrigendum/addendum etc. or updates with regard to this advertisement shall be made available on our website www.sjvn.nic.in. Candidates are thus advised to periodically visit our website as all further correspondence and latest information shall be available only on our website.
  • The decision of Management will be final & binding on all candidates on all matters relating to eligibility, acceptance or rejection of the applications, mode of selection, cancellation of the selection process either in part or full, higher qualification etc. No correspondence will be entertained in this regard. Selection Process

Selection will be made through Computer Based Test (CBT) / Written Screening Test followed by Document Verification.

  • Computer Based Test (CBT): 120 Marks (Duration: 1½ Hours)
    • 120 Multiple Choice Questions (1 mark each)
    • Part (i): Subjects/fields upto the level of prescribed essential qualification (Diploma/B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering)
    • Part (ii):
      • (a) General Knowledge including General Knowledge of Himachal Pradesh & Current Affairs
      • (b) Everyday Science, Logical Reasoning, Social Science, General English & General Hindi of Matric Standard
  • Minimum Qualifying Marks: 45% for General Category | 40% for SC/ST/OBC/WFF Categories (relaxable by maximum 5% if number of qualified candidates is less than vacancies)
  • In case of multiple shifts, scores will be normalized using Z-Score Method (Mean & Standard Deviation Method)
  • Document Verification of original certificates will be conducted for shortlisted candidates
  • Final selection is based on merit of CBT + document verification
  • A category-wise waiting list (panel) will also be prepared
  • Selected candidates will be engaged as Job Trainee under Job Trainee Scheme-2025 (consolidated honorarium ₹23,500/- p.m.)

How to Apply

Application Mode: Online only through the official website https://hprea.hp.gov.in

Steps to Apply:

  1. Candidates must first register on the One Time Registration (OTR) portal.
  2. Login with OTR credentials and fill the Online Recruitment Application (ORA) Form with all mandatory details (Name, Father’s Name, Mother’s Name, Date of Birth exactly as per Matric certificate, category, etc.).
  3. Upload scanned copies of:
    • Recent passport-size photograph (not older than 1 month)
    • Signature
    • Matric/10+2 certificate, Diploma/B.E./B.Tech marksheets & degree
    • Category certificates (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/BPL/WFF/PwD etc.)
    • Any other required documents
  4. Pay the examination & processing fee online through Credit Card/Debit Card/Net Banking.
  5. Submit the application and take a printout for future reference.
  6. Correction window will open for 7 days (after 3 days of closing date) with additional fee of ₹100/-.

DBT Note: An additional Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) amount of ₹4,000/month for Diploma Apprentices and ₹4,500/month for Graduate Apprentices is provided by the Government of India under the NATS scheme. The above stipend figures are inclusive of DBT wherever applicable. Candidates must have an active Aadhaar-seeded, DBT-enabled bank account.

Age Limit

Candidates must be between 18 and 30 years of age. Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC and other reserved categories will be applicable as per Government of India guidelines.

Reservation

Reservation will be followed as per the Apprentice Act 1961. Candidates claiming reservation must submit the requisite certificate in the prescribed Government format issued by the competent authority. Failure to do so will result in the candidate being treated as General category.

NHPC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

There will be no written examination or interview. Selection will be entirely based on merit, calculated from the candidates' academic performance.

Graduate Apprentice

  • 10th Class: 20%
  • 12th/Diploma (higher of the two): 20%
  • Engineering/Graduation/PG:60%
  • Total:100

Diploma Technician

  • 10th Class:30%
  • Diploma in Engineering:70%
  • Total:100

ITI Technician

  • 10th Class:30%
  • ITI in Concerned Trade:70%
  • Total: 100

Preference in Selection

Based on merit, preference will be given in the following order:

  1. Candidates from Project Affected Families of the respective Project/Power Station.
  2. Candidates from the concerned district(s) of the State/UT where the project is located.
  3. Candidates from the State/UT where the project is located.
  4. Candidates from other States/UTs based on merit.

NHPC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

As per the official advertisement, no application fee has been prescribed for candidates applying for any category of NHPC Apprentice posts 2026.

How to Apply for NHPC Apprentice Recruitment 2026

The application process is online only and consists of two steps - first registering on the NAPS/NATS portal, then applying on the NHPC official website.

  1. Register on NAPS/NATS Portal: ITI trade candidates must register on NAPS at apprenticeshipindia.gov.in. Graduate/Diploma trade candidates must register on NATS at nats.education.gov.in. Complete your profile and upload all required documents.
  2. Note your Registration/Enrolment Number: After completing registration, note your NAPS/NATS enrolment number carefully - it will be required for the NHPC application form.
  3. Apply on NHPC Website: Visit nhpcindia.com → Career Section → Engagement of Apprentice → Apply Now. Fill in all required details including trade, personal information, educational qualifications, category and NAPS/NATS enrolment number.
  4. Upload Documents: Upload scanned copies of - NAPS/NATS Registration Form, 10th Marksheet (Age proof), ITI/Diploma/Degree Marksheets, SC/ST/OBC(NCL) Certificate (if applicable), recent passport-size colour photograph, and signature.
  5. Submit & Save: Review all entries carefully and submit the application before 06 May 2026, 5:00 PM. Save/print a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

Note: candidates should apply for only one region/state/trade. 

Important: Applications made through any mode other than the NHPC official website will not be accepted. Candidates awaiting final results of qualifying examinations and those who have already undergone apprenticeship training of 1 year or more are not eligible to apply.

HPRCA Teacher Recruitment 2026 Exam Pattern

The mode of selection will be Computer Based Test (CBT) or OMR-based written screening test of 120 marks of 1½ hours (one and a half hours) duration or as decided by the Aayog.

The objective type screening test will consist of 120 multiple-choice questions, with each question carrying 1 mark.

Syllabus:

The CBT will cover two broad areas: (i) Subjects/fields up to the level of prescribed essential qualification(s) as notified in the advertisement; and (ii) (a) General Knowledge including General Knowledge of Himachal Pradesh and Current Affairs, and (b) Everyday Science, Logical Reasoning, Social Science, General English and General Hindi etc. of Matric Standard.

Qualifying Marks:

The minimum qualifying marks of written screening test/OMR/CBT shall be at least 45% marks for General category candidates and 40% marks for SC/ST/OBC/Ward of Freedom Fighters candidates. However, if the number of candidates securing the prescribed percentage is less than the number of advertised posts, the Aayog may relax the qualifying percentage by a maximum of 5%, i.e., up to 40% for General category and 35% for SC/ST/OBC/WFF candidates, for reasons to be recorded in writing.

In case of multiple shifts CBT examination, the score of candidates shall be normalized using Z-Score Method (Mean and Standard Deviation Method) for preparation of the merit list.

Normalization Formula: Xn = (S2/S1) * (X - Xav) + Yav, where Xn is the candidate's normalized score, S2 is the SD of the shift with the highest average score (base), S1 is the SD of the corresponding shift, X is the raw score, Xav is the simple average of the shift, and Yav is the average of the base shift.

HPRCA Teacher Recruitment 2026 Terms of Engagement

Selected teachers will be engaged under the "Scheme for the Engagements of Teachers in Government Schools Affiliated to Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) on Fixed Honorarium/Consolidated Amount" (Annexure-I) notified by the Government of Himachal Pradesh, Department of School Education vide notification No. EDN-B-A(1)-3/2025 dated 01.04.2026. Key terms are as follows:

The engagement is purely temporary for a period of 5 years and is not against any sanctioned post of TGT/PGT/PRT. Teachers shall not be deemed to be Government employees in any manner. The fixed honorarium of ₹30,000/- per month is payable for 10 months in an academic year only and shall not be treated as salary. There is no right to regularization against any vacant sanctioned post. Service Rules including CCS/CCA/Leave Rules/Pension Rule applicable to Government servants shall not apply. Teachers will be entitled to 10 days Casual Leave and 5 days Medical Leave in a year. Teachers shall be eligible for Medical benefit schemes under HIMCARE/Ayushman Bharat if eligible. The selected candidates shall be liable to be posted anywhere within the State. The Government medical rules for reimbursement claims shall not be applicable to these teachers.

HPRCA Teacher Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

The selection for HPRCA Teacher Recruitment 2026 will be based on the following stages:

Computer Based Test (CBT): Candidates will be shortlisted on the basis of merit order in the CBT/OMR screening test of 120 marks conducted by the Aayog. No personal interview will be held.

Merit List & Waiting Panel: A category-wise merit list will be prepared based on marks secured in the CBT. In case of a tie, the merit will be determined on the basis of marks obtained in the essential qualification, then by age (senior preferred), and then alphabetically. A waiting panel shall also be prepared: up to 25 advertised posts - 25%; between 25 to 50 posts - 15%; above 50 posts - 10%, subject to minimum numbers. The waiting panel is valid for one year from the date of sending recommendation to the appointing authority.

Document Verification: Shortlisted candidates as per merit will be called for document verification. Candidates must produce all original certificates/documents and self-attested photocopies. The downloaded/printed copy of the online application form along with necessary original certificates and self-attested photocopies must be produced at the time of document verification. No Offline Application Form will be accepted.

Final Recommendation: After document verification, the Aayog will recommend candidates to the appointing authority. Recommendations of the Aayog will be valid till the appointments are offered to the candidates by the Appointing Authority.

Counseling/Allocation: After selection, allocation of schools/posts will be done through merit-based counseling as per Government guidelines.

How to Apply for HPRCA Teacher Recruitment 2026

Eligible candidates must submit their application online through the official website hprca.hp.gov.in. The candidate must be registered on the One Time Registration (OTR) portal before filling the ORA. No Offline Application Form will be accepted by the HPRCA.

Step 1 - Sign Up: Visit the HPRCA portal https://hprca.hp.gov.in and click on the "Sign Up" option to create a username and password.

Step 2 - One-Time Registration (OTR): After successful sign-up, complete the One-Time Registration by providing personal information, educational qualifications, work experience (if any), uploading a recent photograph and signature, and uploading relevant supporting documents. This information is stored in the user's profile and can be utilized for future applications.

Step 3 - Complete/Update Profile: Only users who have completed their profile can apply for posts. If any updates are required (e.g., change in qualification or contact details), the candidate can edit their profile before applying.

Step 4 - Apply for a Post: Once the profile is complete, view the list of available posts on the HPRCA portal (https://hprca.hp.gov.in) and click on the "Apply" button corresponding to the desired post. Candidates are allowed to submit only one application form against each post.

Step 5 - Select Preferred Exam District: Select your preferred district(s) for the examination from the dropdown menu. Candidates may opt for three Test Cities from the list as per their preferences. MCL/HPRCA reserves the right to allocate any Test City. The same cannot be changed after the online form is submitted.

Step 6 - Confirm Application Details: The system will automatically fill your application form using the information from your profile. Please review all details carefully - including name, father's name, mother's name, date of birth (as per Matric Certificate), category, sub-category, age, essential qualifications, and scanned photograph (passport size, not older than one month, JPG/JPEG/PNG, max 1 MB) and scanned signature (JPG/JPEG/PNG, max 1 MB) - before proceeding.

Step 7 - Pay Application Fee: Proceed to make the application fee payment of ₹800/- through the available Online Payment Gateway using Credit Card/Debit Card/Net Banking. Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances.

Step 8 - Application Submission Confirmation: After successful payment, your application will be considered complete. Take a printout of the online application form for future reference.

Correction Window: A correction window shall be opened for a period of four days commencing after the closing date for submission of ORAs. During this window, candidates shall be permitted to rectify errors in their ORAs subject to payment of ₹100/- correction fee through the prescribed payment gateway.

Note: The candidates must read the instructions carefully before filling up the ORA for the post(s) concerned. Incomplete ORA submitted without prescribed essential qualifications, age, date of birth, category, requisite examination fee and other processing fees, scanned photograph and signatures of prescribed size etc. will be rejected straightway. The candidates are strictly advised to apply online well in advance to avoid rush during closing dates.

HPRCA Teacher Recruitment 2026 Documents Required

Candidates must keep the following documents/certificates ready (as copies to be uploaded in the ORA and originals to be produced at the time of document verification):

  • Matriculation Certificate (for age proof)
  • Degree/Diploma/Certificates along with Mark Sheets of all years in support of educational qualifications as prescribed under the Essential Qualification column
  • Provisional Certificate(s) along with mark sheets of all semesters/years
  • Experience Certificate(s) wherever required - must be attained after acquiring qualification (Degree/Diploma) and duly verified/counter-signed by the concerned Government Authority/Departmental Officer
  • Caste Certificates (SC/ST/OBC) on parental basis in prescribed format issued by competent authority
  • BPL Certificate (if applicable) - valid for 6 months from date of issuance
  • EWS Certificate (valid for one year from date of issuance - should be valid on last date of ORA as well as on date of document verification)
  • Ward of Freedom Fighter/WFF Certificate (if applicable)
  • Other Certificates required for determining eligibility as per the mode of selection criteria that apply to the applicants.

All certificates required in support of eligibility, category claims, experience etc. shall be in the prescribed format, failing which the candidature is liable to be rejected.

Note: The downloaded copy of the online application form along with necessary original certificates and self-attested photocopies must be brought at the time of document verification or to submit the same whenever required by the HPRCA to ascertain the eligibility of applicants.

Selection Process

Computer Based Test (CBT) / Written Screening Test of 120 marks of 1 ½ hours (one and a half hours) duration or as decided by the Aayog.

Syllabus The objective type screening test will consist of 120 multiple-choice questions, with each question carrying 1 mark.

i) Subject(s)/field(s) upto the level of prescribed essential qualification(s) as notified in the advertisement. ii) (a) General Knowledge including General Knowledge of Himachal Pradesh, Current Affairs. (b) Everyday Science, Logical Reasoning, Social Science, General English & General Hindi etc. of Matric Standard.

However, the HPRCA may issue a detailed syllabus on its official website in due course of time.

Minimum Qualifying Marks

  • General Category: 45%
  • SC/ST/OBC/Wards of Freedom Fighters: 40%

If the number of candidates securing the prescribed percentage is less than the advertised posts, the Aayog may relax the qualifying percentage by a maximum of 5% (i.e., upto 40% for General and 35% for reserved categories) for reasons to be recorded in writing.

Normalization of Scores (for multiple shifts CBT) Scores shall be normalized using Z-Score Method (Mean and Standard Deviation Method) for preparation of the merit list.

Further Process

  • Shortlisting for Document Verification based on merit.
  • Final selection/allocation on the basis of “Merit-Cum-Option-Cum-Availability of Post” formula.
  • Category-wise waiting list/panel shall be prepared (25%/15%/10% of posts as per rules).
  • Recommendations valid till appointments are offered by the Appointing Authority.
  • Selected candidates liable to be posted anywhere within the State.

How to Apply

Online Applications only – No Offline Application Form will be accepted.

Steps to Fill Up Online Application Form Step 1: Sign Up – Register on the HPRCA portal by clicking “Sign Up” to create username and password.

Step 2: One-Time Registration (OTR) – Complete OTR with:

  • Personal information
  • Educational qualifications
  • Work experience (if any)
  • Upload recent photograph & signature
  • Upload relevant supporting documents

Step 3: Complete/Update Profile – Only users with completed profile can apply. Edit if required.

Step 4: Apply for a Post – View available posts → Click “Apply”.

Step 5: Preferred Exam District – Select preferred district(s). (HPRCA reserves the right to allot any centre.)

Step 6: Confirm Application Details – System auto-fills from profile; review carefully.

Step 7: Pay Application Fee – Through Online Payment Gateway (Credit/Debit Card/Net Banking).

Step 8: Application Submission Confirmation – After successful payment, application is complete.

Important

  • Candidates must be registered on One Time Registration (OTR) portal before filling ORA.
  • Only one application per post. Multiple applications liable to rejection.
  • Correction window (4 days after closing date) – Fee ₹100/-.
  • Keep mobile number and email ID active till completion of selection process.

General Instructions

  • Date for determining eligibility = closing date i.e. 08.05.2026 (11:59 PM).
  • Age reckoned as on 01.01.2026.
  • Category certificates (OBC, BPL/EWS, WFF etc.) must be valid on both closing date and date of document verification.
  • Reserved category candidates of other States treated as General (UR).
  • PwBD/PwD candidates can avail scribe/reader + compensatory time (20 min per hour) after prior approval.
  • Examination & processing fee once paid non-refundable.
  • Provisional admission to CBT; final eligibility determined at document verification.
  • Admit Card downloadable from website only (no postal dispatch).
  • Candidates must bring downloaded ORA + original certificates at document verification.
  • No change in category claimed after correction window.
  • Meritorious reserved candidates considered only in their reserved category (not UR).
  • Waiting list valid for one year from date of recommendation.
  • Any dispute subject to Court jurisdiction of HP.
  • HPRCA reserves right to change terms, rectify errors, club posts, etc.
  • Selected teachers engaged purely on Scheme basis – temporary (5 years), fixed honorarium only, not Government employees, no regularization claim, service rules not applicable.

How to Apply for CSC e‑Governance Services Indian Aadhaar Supervisor/Operator Recruitment 2026

Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online only through the official CSC e‑Governance Services Indian website. Follow the steps given below to submit your application form.

Visit Official Website

  • Go to the official CSC e‑Governance Services Indian website: csc.gov.in.

  • On the homepage, navigate to the Recruitment/Careers/Latest Opening section.

Open Aadhaar Supervisor/Operator Application Link

  • Find and click on the notification/link titled “CSC e‑Governance Services Indian Aadhaar Supervisor/ Operator Recruitment 2026” or similar.

  • Click on the Apply Online button to proceed to the application page.

Registration (New Users)

  • Click on New Registration (if applying for the first time).

  • Enter basic details such as Name, Mobile Number, Email ID, Date of Birth, and create a password.

  • Submit the details to generate your Registration ID and Password (note these for future login).

Login and Fill Application Form

  • Login using your Registration ID and Password.

  • Fill in the online application form carefully with personal details, contact details, educational qualification, Aadhaar Supervisor/Operator certificate details, and preferred state/district.

  • Ensure that all details match your certificates and Aadhaar data.

Upload Documents

  • Upload scanned copies of the following documents in the prescribed format and size (as mentioned in the notification):

    • Recent passport size photograph

    • Signature

    • 10th/12th/ITI/Polytechnic Diploma certificates and mark sheets

    • Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor Certificate issued by UIDAI‑authorized Testing & Certifying Agency

    • Any other documents required as per notification

  • Preview the uploaded documents and confirm that they are clear and readable.

Application Fee Payment (If Applicable)

  • Check the Application Fee section in the official notification.

  • If any fee is prescribed, pay it online through available modes such as Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking, or UPI.

  • After successful payment, download/print the fee receipt.

Final Submission

  • Carefully review all the details filled in the application form in the Preview section.

  • If required, make corrections before final submission.

  • Click on Final Submit to complete the application process.

Print Application Form

  • After successful submission, download and take a printout of the final submitted application form for future reference.

  • Keep the Registration ID, Password, and printout safe for further recruitment stages.

SSB ASI Eligibility Criteria 2026

Candidates who wish to apply for SSB ASI Recruitment 2026 must ensure that they fulfil the required age limit and educational qualification for the Assistant Sub Inspector posts in the paramedical cadre.

  • Age Limit: 18 to 27 years as on 20 April 2026 (last date of application). Upper age relaxation is applicable for SC, ST, OBC, Ex-servicemen and other reserved categories as per Government rules.
  • Nationality: The applicant must be a citizen of India.

Post Wise SSB Assistant Sub Inspector Qualification

  • ASI (Radiographer): 12th pass with Science + 2 years Diploma in Medical Imaging Technology / Radiography from a recognised institute + minimum 1 year experience as Radiographer in a recognised Radiology Imaging Centre or 100 bedded hospital.
  • ASI (Pharmacist): 12th pass with Science + 2 years Diploma in Pharmacy from a recognised institution + registered as Pharmacist under Pharmacy Act, 1948 + minimum 1 year experience as Pharmacist in a 100 bedded hospital.
  • ASI (Operation Theatre Technician): 12th pass from a recognised board + Diploma in Operation Theatre Technology from a recognised institute + relevant experience as OT Technician/Assistant in a recognised hospital.
  • ASI (Dental Technician): 12th pass with Science + Diploma/Certificate in Dental Technician/Mechanic course from a recognised institute + experience in dental lab/department of recognised hospital as per notification.

SSB ASI Salary 2026

Candidates selected through SSB ASI Recruitment 2026 will be appointed as Assistant Sub Inspector in the paramedical cadre and will receive salary as per the 7th Central Pay Commission. All posts under SSB Assistant Sub Inspector Recruitment 2026 carry the same pay level in the pay matrix.

Post Name Pay Level SSB ASI Salary 2026 (Basic Pay)
ASI (Radiographer) Level-5 ₹29,200 – ₹92,300/-
ASI (Pharmacist) Level-5 ₹29,200 – ₹92,300/-
ASI (Operation Theatre Technician) Level-5 ₹29,200 – ₹92,300/-
ASI (Dental Technician) Level-5 ₹29,200 – ₹92,300/-

Along with the basic pay, SSB ASI paramedical staff are entitled to Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance (HRA), Ration Money, Transport Allowance, dress allowance and other admissible benefits as per SSB and Central Government rules, making the in-hand SSB ASI salary 2026 approximately in the range of ₹40,000 to ₹50,000 per month depending on posting location and allowances.

SSB ASI Selection Process 2026

The selection process for SSB ASI Recruitment 2026 will be conducted in multiple stages to assess the physical fitness, knowledge and medical standards of the candidates. Only those who qualify each stage of the SSB Assistant Sub Inspector selection process 2026 will be considered for final appointment.

  • Physical Standard Test (PST): Measurement of height, chest and weight as per SSB ASI paramedical standards. Candidates who do not meet the prescribed physical standards will be disqualified at this stage.
  • Physical Efficiency Test (PET): Running and other endurance events as per Sashastra Seema Bal norms for Assistant Sub Inspector posts (pattern similar to other SSB non‑GD posts; details are given in the notification).
  • Written Examination: Objective type written test/CBT consisting of questions from General Knowledge, Reasoning, Numerical Ability, General English/Hindi and technical/paramedical subject related to the ASI post.
  • Skill/Trade Test (if applicable): Practical test to assess professional skills for posts like Radiographer, Pharmacist, OT Technician and Dental Technician as per SSB ASI recruitment rules.
  • Document Verification: Verification of original documents such as educational certificates, diplomas, experience certificates, caste certificate, age proof, identity proof and other required documents.
  • Medical Examination: Detailed Medical Examination (DME) and Review Medical Examination (RME), if required, to check fitness as per SSB medical standards for paramilitary service.
  • Final Merit List: Preparation of final merit list of candidates qualified in all stages, based on marks in written/technical tests and subject to qualifying PET, PST and medical standards.

SSB ASI Application Fees 2026

Candidates applying for SSB ASI Recruitment 2026 have to pay the prescribed examination fee online as per their category. The SSB Assistant Sub Inspector application fee 2026 once paid will not be refunded or adjusted for any other recruitment.

Category SSB ASI Application Fee 2026
General / OBC / EWS Rs. 100/-
SC / ST Nil (No Fee)
Female Candidates Nil (Exempted)
Ex-Servicemen Nil (Exempted)
Mode of Payment Online – Net Banking, UPI, Credit Card, Debit Card

The SSB ASI exam fee 2026 must be paid through online payment gateways only; offline/challan payments will not be accepted as per the notification.

Application Form

The online application process for SSB ASI Recruitment 2026 has been started as per the schedule mentioned in the official notification and candidates can submit the SSB Assistant Sub Inspector application form 2026 only in online mode. Eligible applicants must visit the official website ssb.gov.in and complete their SSB ASI online form 2026 with correct details, documents and fee payment before the last date of registration.

Click to Apply for SSB ASI Recruitment 2026

How to Apply for SSB ASI Recruitment 2026

Candidates must submit the SSB ASI online form 2026 through the official Sashastra Seema Bal website only. Follow the step by step process given below to apply online for SSB Assistant Sub Inspector Recruitment 2026.

  • Step 1: Visit the official SSB recruitment website – recruitment.ssb.gov.in or go to ssb.gov.in and open the recruitment/advertisement section.
  • Step 2: Find and click on the link for “SSB Assistant Sub Inspector (ASI) Recruitment 2026” and read the notification PDF carefully to check eligibility, age limit and other conditions.
  • Step 3: Click on the “Apply Online” / “New Registration” button and complete the registration using a valid mobile number and email ID.
  • Step 4: Login with your registration details and fill the SSB ASI application form 2026 with correct personal information, communication details and category details as per your matriculation certificate.
  • Step 5: Enter post wise educational qualification, diploma, experience details for Radiographer / Pharmacist / OT Technician / Dental Technician as applicable.
  • Step 6: Upload scanned copies of your recent passport size photograph, signature and required documents in the prescribed format and size mentioned in the SSB ASI notification 2026.
  • Step 7: Pay the SSB ASI application fee 2026 online through Net Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card or UPI (fee exempted categories need not pay).
  • Step 8: Preview all the details filled in the form carefully, then submit the online application form.
  • Step 9: Download and take a printout of the final submitted SSB ASI online form and fee receipt for future reference.
