SSB Head Constable Selection Process 2026

  • Stage I – Physical Efficiency Test (PET) & Physical Standard Test (PST):
    • PET – Male: 1.6 Km run in 6 Minutes 30 Seconds; Female: 800 Meter race in 4 minutes.
    • Ex-Servicemen are exempted from PET but must appear in PST, Written Examination, Skill Test (as applicable), Documentation and Medical Examination.
    • PST – Candidates must meet prescribed height and chest standards (post-wise and category-wise as per notification).
    • General (UR/EWS/OBC): Male – 165 cm height, 75–80 cm chest; Female – 155 cm height (Head Constable Steward). Different standards apply for SC/ST, NE States, J&K and other specified categories.
  • Stage II – Written Examination (Computer Based Test – CBT):
    • Paper-I Common Entrance Test: 3 hours duration, 150 marks, 150 multiple-choice objective type questions.
    • Part-I (50 Marks): General Knowledge, Mathematics, Reasoning, General English/General Hindi.
    • Part-II (100 Marks): Technical Subject.
    • Minimum qualifying marks: 50% for Gen/EWS/OBC/Ex-SM; 45% for SC/ST.
    • Final Merit will be prepared on the basis of marks obtained by candidates in the written examination.
  • Stage III – Skill Test (Only for Head Constable Electrician):
    • Skill test will be conducted for up to 20 times the vacancies (category-wise) for the post of Head Constable (Electrician).
    • Skill test carries 50 marks; minimum qualifying marks for all categories including SC/ST/OBC/EWS/Ex-Servicemen: 60%.
    • Skill test is qualifying in nature. Marks of skill test will not be included in the final merit list.
  • Stage IV – Document Verification (DV) and Detailed Medical Examination (DME) / Review Medical Examination (RME):
    • Candidates shortlisted up to 3 times the vacancies (category-wise) will be called for Documentation and DME/RME.
    • All original documents will be verified by detailed BOOs of SSB.
    • Candidates declared unfit in DME may prefer an appeal for Review Medical Examination (RME). The decision of RME Board will be final and no 2nd appeal will be entertained.
  • Final Selection: Final selection list will be prepared in order of merit, category-wise, after completion of Review Medical Examination. Where equal marks are obtained: candidate with more marks in Part-II (Technical Subject) will rank higher; if still equal, senior in age will rank higher; if date of birth is also same, priority based on alphabetical order of names in English.

SSB Head Constable Exam Pattern 2026

The written examination for SSB Head Constable (Steward, Communication, Electrician & Veterinary) will be conducted in Computer Based Test mode with objective-type questions from General Knowledge, Mathematics, Reasoning, General English/General Hindi and technical subjects relevant to the trade. Detailed syllabus, marking scheme, language of question paper and sample pattern will be published with the detailed notification and on the official SSB recruitment website, and candidates are advised to refer to the latest scheme before starting preparation.

Medical Standards: Both eye sights should be 6/6 without correction and without wearing glasses. Candidates must not suffer from knock-knees, flat foot, varicose veins or squint in the eyes, and must possess high colour vision and be in good mental and bodily health.

SSF Constable Recruitment 2025 Selection Process

The SSF Constable (Barber & Washerman) Recruitment 2025 selection will be conducted in four phases:

  • Phase I – Physical Efficiency Test (PET): Qualifying in nature; no marks awarded. Events include 1.6 km Race (within 7.30 minutes), Long Jump (11 feet, 3 chances), and High Jump (3½ feet, 3 chances). Candidates failing any event will be eliminated. PET will not be held for Ex-Servicemen.
  • Phase I – Physical Standard Test (PST): Candidates who qualify PET will be screened for Height, Chest and Weight measurements. Those not meeting the required physical standards will be eliminated. Candidates may appeal on the same day to the Appellate Authority through the Presiding Officer.
  • Phase II – Written Examination (50 Marks): Objective type Multiple Choice Questions (OMR or CBT) of 1 hour duration covering General Awareness/GK (15 marks), Elementary Mathematics (10 marks), Analytical Aptitude (15 marks), and English/Hindi (10 marks). Minimum qualifying marks: 18 for UR & Ex-Servicemen; 17 for SC & OBC. No negative marking.
  • Phase III – Trade Test (50 Marks): Candidates who qualify the written examination (10 times the category-wise vacancies) will appear for a Trade Test. Qualifying marks are 50% for all categories. Trade Test is qualifying in nature only.
  • For Constable (Barber): Hair cutting of various types (20 marks), Body/head massage (15 marks), Knowledge of tools/machines used in trade (15 marks).
  • For Constable (Washerman): Washing of various types of clothes (15 marks), Ironing of clothes (10 marks), Knowledge about dry-cleaning of clothes (10 marks), Knowledge about use of various detergents/washing powders/soaps (15 marks).
  • Phase IV – Verification of Original Documents & Detailed Medical Examination (DME): Shortlisted candidates will undergo document verification followed by Detailed Medical Examination. Candidates declared unfit in DME may undergo Review Medical Examination (RME) by giving written consent within 24 hours.

Selection Process

The recruitment process will consist of Physical Efficiency Test (PET), Physical Standards Test (PST), Computer Based Test (CBT), Trade/Skill Test, Document Verification (DV) and Medical Examination (DME/RME).

  • Physical Efficiency Test (PET): Qualifying in nature.
    • For Constable (Driver, Motor Mechanic Vehicle, Gardner, Painter, Carpenter, Brass Band, Pipe Band, Cobbler, Tailor & Bugler): Male – 5 Kms race in 24 minutes; Female – 1.6 Kms in 8.30 minutes.
    • For Constable (Cook/Water Carrier, Barber & Hair Dresser, Washer man & Washer women, Safai Karmachari): Male – 1.6 Kms in 10 minutes; Female – 1.6 Kms in 12 minutes.
    • For Pioneer Wing (Mason / Electrician): Male – 1.6 Kms in 09 minutes.
    • Pregnant women candidates will be declared temporarily unfit.
  • Physical Standards Test (PST): Height, Chest (for males only) & Weight (proportionate to height & age).
    • Height: Male – 170 Cms (minimum); Female – 157 Cms (minimum). Relaxations applicable for certain categories (ST, NE States, Gorkhas, etc.).
    • Chest (Male only): Un-expanded – 80 Cms, Minimum expansion – 05 Cms. Relaxations applicable.
    • Candidates failing PST will be eliminated.
  • Computer Based Test (CBT): 100 marks (100 MCQs), duration 02 hours.
    • General Intelligence & Reasoning – 25 Qs / 25 Marks
    • General Knowledge & General Awareness – 25 Qs / 25 Marks
    • Elementary Mathematics – 25 Qs / 25 Marks
    • English/Hindi – 25 Qs / 25 Marks
    • Negative marking of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer.
    • Qualifying marks: UR – 30%, EWS/OBC – 25%, SC/ST & others – 20%.
    • Marks will be normalized. Merit list prepared on CBT marks.
  • Trade/Skill Test: Qualifying in nature (50 marks, minimum 20 marks required). Practical assessment of the applied trade/post.
  • Document Verification (DV): Original documents (Matric certificate, Domicile/PRC, Trade certificates, Caste/EWS/ESM certificates, etc.) will be verified.
  • Detailed Medical Examination (DME) / Review Medical Examination (RME): As per Uniform Guidelines issued by MHA. Temporary unfitness allowed only for pregnancy. Final selection subject to medical fitness.
  • Final merit list prepared on the basis of marks obtained in CBT (subject to qualifying all stages). Separate merit lists for male/female and each State/UT (All India basis for Pioneer posts).

How to Apply

Application Mode: Online only through CRPF website. No other mode will be accepted.

Steps to Apply:

  1. Visit the official website www.rect.crpf.gov.in.
  2. Click on the link for “Recruitment for the post of Constable (Technical & Tradesmen and Pioneer) 2026”.
  3. Register by providing basic details and generate Provisional Registration Number & Password.
  4. Fill the online application form carefully (personal details, educational qualification, trade/post applied, State/UT of domicile, etc.).
  5. Upload scanned copies of recent colour passport size photograph, signature, left thumb impression and handwritten declaration as per specifications.
  6. Pay the application fee online (if applicable) through BHIM, UPI, Net Banking, Debit/Credit Card or CSC Wallet.
  7. Submit the application and take printout of the application form & e-receipt for future reference.
  8. Candidates should bring two coloured printouts of the Admit Card at every stage of examination.

INMAS DRDO Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27 Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification: Candidates must hold the relevant Diploma, ITI Certificate or Graduate degree (B.Sc./B.Pharma/B.L.I.Sc.) in the applicable discipline as specified in the vacancy table above. Only fresh pass-out candidates who have passed their respective qualifying course in the year 2022 or later are eligible to apply. Candidates who passed their qualifying examination before 2022 are not eligible. Candidates with a post-graduation degree are also not eligible to apply.

Only those candidates who have completed their qualifying examination as regular candidates (not through distance/correspondence mode) are eligible.

Graduate or Diploma holders who have undergone training or have job experience of one year or more after attaining the essential qualification are NOT eligible for engagement as an Apprentice under the Act.

Age Limit: Not specifically mentioned. Candidates should refer to the Apprentices Act 1961 as amended in 1961, 1973 and 2014 for applicable age norms.

Reservation: Reservation will be applied as per the provisions of the Apprentices Act 1961 as amended and Apprenticeship Rules 1992 as amended from time to time. Candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer)/EWS/PwD categories must produce their caste/relevant certificates in the prescribed format issued by the Competent Authority.

A Board constituted by the Director, INMAS will review all applications and shortlist candidates as per the vacancies indicated. Only selected candidates will be informed about further proceedings.

Important: Canvassing or personal follow-up with the intention of influencing the selection process will lead to immediate disqualification of the candidate.

Step 2 – Login and Search Establishment: For candidates with Technical/Engineering subjects, apply through the Establishment user ID NDLNOC000005 (INMAS/Institute of Nuclear Medicine and Allied Sciences) on the portal www.mhrdnats.gov.in.

Step 3 – Verify Eligibility: Before applying, ensure that you fulfill all eligibility criteria including the qualifying course, pass-out year (2022 or later), regular candidate status, and that you do not hold a post-graduation degree or prior training/job experience of 1 year or more in the relevant field.

Step 4 – Fill and Submit Application: Fill in all required personal details, educational qualification details, discipline, category, and reservation claims carefully and submit the application online before 30 April 2026.

Step 5 – Keep Records: Save a copy of the submitted application for future reference. Selected candidates will be required to submit a Medical Fitness Certificate at the time of joining and execute a contract for 12 months of training as per the Apprentices Act 1961.

SSB Paramedical Selection Process 2026

The SSB Paramedical Selection Process 2026 consists of the following stages:

  • Stage I – Physical Efficiency Test (PET):
    • HC (Lab Assistant) & HC (Physiotherapy Assistant): Male – 1.6 km in 6 min 30 sec; Female – 800 m in 4 min
    • Constable (Nursing Assistant cum Medic): Male – 4.8 km in 24 min; Female – 2.4 km in 18 min
    • Ex-Servicemen are exempted from PET
  • Stage I – Physical Standard Test (PST): Height and chest measurement as per category-wise norms (General/UR/OBC/EWS: Male 165 cm, Female 155 cm; chest for males 75–80 cm; relaxations for ST, NE States, Garhwali, Kumaoni, Dogra, Maratha, J&K/Ladakh candidates).
  • Stage II – Written Examination (Computer Based Test):
    • HC (Lab Assistant & Physiotherapy Assistant): 150 marks, 3 hours, 150 MCQs – Part I (50 marks): GK, Maths, Reasoning, General English/Hindi; Part II (100 marks): Technical Subject. Negative marking: 0.25 per wrong answer.
    • Constable (Nursing Assistant cum Medic): 100 marks, 2 hours, 100 MCQs – GK, Maths, Reasoning, General English/Hindi. Negative marking: 0.25 per wrong answer.
  • Stage III – Documentation & Detailed Medical Examination (DME) / Review Medical Examination (RME): Top 3 times the number of vacancies (category-wise) from written exam will be called. Final merit list drawn on written exam marks.

The selection process for ITBP Assistant Commandant (Engineer) is comprehensive and multi-staged, designed to assess physical fitness, academic knowledge, and overall personality. The process begins with a Physical Standard Test (PST) and Physical Efficiency Test (PET), followed by a Written Examination (two papers), Document Verification, a Personal Interview/Personality Test, Detailed Medical Examination (DME), and finally a Review Medical Examination (RME) for those declared unfit in DME.

The final merit list is prepared based on combined marks of the Written Examination and Interview. Biometric enrolment is mandatory at the PST/PET stage and may be verified at any subsequent stage. SSB Constable Tradesman & Driver Selection Process 2026

  • Physical Efficiency Test (PET): For Constables (Veterinary, Driver, Gardener, Water Carrier, Cobbler, Tailor, Washerman, Barber, Waiter, Carpenter & Nursing Orderly), PET consists of 4.8 km race in 24 minutes for male candidates and 2.4 km race in 18 minutes for female candidates; Ex-Servicemen are exempted from PET but must appear for other stages.

  • Written Examination: Objective-type written test as per SSB pattern covering General Knowledge, Elementary Mathematics, Reasoning and Trade-related subjects; detailed scheme and syllabus will be notified on the SSB website.
  • Trade/Skill Test: Practical trade test for Tradesman posts and driving/maintenance test for Constable (Driver) to assess hands-on skills; qualifying in nature as per prescribed criteria.
  • Documentation & Medical Examination: Verification of original documents, certificates, category and age proofs followed by medical examination as per SSB medical standards; only medically fit candidates will be considered for final selection.

SSC Selection Post Phase 14 Application Fee 2026

  • For General / OBC / EWS candidates: ₹100/- examination fee to be paid online.
  • For Women, SC, ST, PwBD and Ex‑Servicemen candidates eligible for reservation: No fee (Exempted) as per SSC rules.
  • Payment Mode: Online through BHIM UPI, Net Banking, or by using Visa, MasterCard, Maestro, RuPay Credit or Debit Cards within the prescribed time limit.

SSC Selection Post Phase 14 Selection Process 2026

  • Computer Based Examination (CBE): SSC will conduct separate CBTs for Matriculation, 10+2 and Graduation & above level posts consisting of Objective Type Multiple Choice Questions with 100 questions (25 each from General Intelligence, General Awareness, Quantitative Aptitude and English Language).
  • Exam Duration: 60 minutes for general candidates and 80 minutes for eligible candidates using scribes; there is negative marking of 0.50 marks for each wrong answer.
  • Skill Tests: Skill Tests like Typing/Data Entry/Computer Proficiency Tests etc., where prescribed for particular posts, will be of qualifying nature and conducted by the User Departments.
  • Document Verification (DV): Shortlisted candidates will be called by the respective User Departments for Document Verification and final selection as per post-wise and category-wise vacancies.

Pay Level Selection Posts are placed in Pay Levels 1 to 8 of the 7th CPC Pay Matrix, varying according to the post and User Department.

SSC Selection Post Phase 14 Documents Required

No supporting documents/certificates are required to be uploaded at the time of online application for SSC Selection Post Phase 14; however, candidates must possess the original documents for verification.

  • Caste certificate for SC/ST/OBC, EWS certificate, PwBD certificate and Ex‑Servicemen documents where applicable, in prescribed formats.
  • Photo identity proof such as Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Driving Licence, Passport etc. for identity verification at exam and DV stages.

How to Apply for SSC Recruitment 2026 (Selection Post Phase 14)

  • Candidates must apply online only through the SSC website https://ssc.gov.in or the mySSC mobile app within the application window from 13-04-2026 to 04-05-2026 (up to 23:00 Hrs).
  • Register on the SSC portal (One‑time registration) if not already registered, using a valid mobile number and email ID, then log in to apply for Selection Post Phase 14.
  • Fill in all details in the online form such as personal information, category, educational qualification, post preferences and exam centre choices accurately as per original documents.
  • Upload scanned photograph and signature in the prescribed format and size as specified in the notification.
  • Pay the application fee (if applicable) through the available online payment modes before 05-05-2026 (up to 23:00 Hrs).
  • Use the “Application Form Correction Window” between 11-05-2026 and 13-05-2026 to correct mistakes if required and pay the correction charges as applicable.
  • After successful submission and fee payment, download/print the final submitted application form for future reference; candidates will be provisionally admitted to the examination subject to verification at later stages.

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • Before filling the online application, candidates must read the full SSC Phase‑XIV/2026 Selection Posts notice carefully and ensure that they meet all eligibility conditions for the posts they apply for.
  • All particulars filled in the online application must match the original certificates, and any mismatch detected at Document Verification will result in cancellation of candidature.
  • Application fee is non‑refundable and no request for change in category, post, exam centre or any other details will be entertained after final submission.
  • Provisional admission to the exam does not imply final selection; final appointment is subject to verification of eligibility, documents and other conditions by User Departments.
  • Candidates are advised to visit SSC’s official website and the websites of User Departments regularly for updates on exam schedule, admit cards, results and DV schedule; no separate correspondence will generally be made.
  • PwBD, Ex‑Servicemen and other reserved category candidates must possess and produce valid certificates in the prescribed format at the time of Document Verification to avail reservation/relaxation benefits.
  • Any form of canvassing, use of unfair means or providing false information will lead to disqualification and possible legal action; SSC’s decision in all matters relating to recruitment will be final and binding.

Territorial Army Commission 2026 Salary / Pay Scale

Officers commissioned in the Territorial Army will receive pay and allowances at par with Regular Army Officers when embodied for training and military service as per the 7th Central Pay Commission (CPC) pay matrix. Commission is granted in the rank of Lieutenant with a pay level of 10 in the pay matrix. In addition to basic pay, officers receive Military Service Pay (MSP) of ₹15,500/- per month.

However, since Territorial Army is a part-time commitment with mandatory two months of training per year, pay and allowances are applicable only during the period of embodiment for training or military service. Serving in the Territorial Army does not guarantee pension, which is subject to embodied service as per organisational requirement. Promotions up to Lt Colonel are by time scale subject to fulfilling laid-down criteria, while promotion to Colonel and Brigadier is by selection.

Candidates are advised to keep a printout of the filled and submitted online application form for future reference.   • Provide valid email ID and active mobile number
  • Select the preferred examination centre carefully (no change will be permitted later)
  • Pay the examination fee of ₹500/- through the prescribed online mode

Territorial Army Commission 2026 Application Form

The online application form for Territorial Army Commission 2026 - Form IAF (TA)-9 (Revised) Part-1 - is available exclusively on the official Indian Army website at www.indianarmy.nic.in. The form requires candidates to fill in their personal details, educational qualification details, employment details, and choice of examination centre. Candidates must ensure all details are accurately filled and match the supporting documents, as any discrepancy found at any stage may lead to disqualification. The online application window is open from 20 April 2026 (1000 Hours) to 19 May 2026 (2355 Hours) only. Candidates who qualify the CBT will additionally be required to download and fill Application Form IAF (TA)-9 (Revised) Part-2 in their own handwriting and bring it at the time of SSB Interview. Candidates must apply well before the last date to avoid any last-minute connectivity or technical issues.

Apply Online at: www.indianarmy.nic.in

Important Instructions for Candidates

Candidates applying for Territorial Army Commission 2026 must carefully read all instructions mentioned in the official notification before submitting their application. Territorial Army is a part-time commitment with mandatory two months of training per year and does not guarantee a full-time career or pension. Serving members of the Regular Army, Navy, Air Force, Police, GREF, Para Military, and like forces are not eligible to apply. DGPM CBIC Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

  • Additional Assistant Director: The post is to be filled on deputation basis. The eligibility criteria including educational qualification, experience, and other conditions are detailed in Annexure-C, available on the CBIC website (www.cbic.gov.in) and DGPM website (https://dgpm.gov.in).

  • Selected officers under DGPM CBIC Additional Assistant Director Recruitment 2026 will be placed at Pay Matrix Level-8 (Rs. 47,600–1,51,100) on deputation basis.
  • After completion of four years of regular service in Level-8, officers will be placed at Level-9 (Rs. 53,100–1,67,800) in the pay matrix.

DGPM CBIC Recruitment 2026 Application Process

  • The nomination/application process for DGPM CBIC Additional Assistant Director Recruitment 2026 is through offline/hard copy mode only via the proper channel. Eligible officers must get their nominations forwarded by their concerned CCAs (Chief Controllers of Accounts) along with NOC and all required documents.
  • Applications/Documents received through e-Office of concerned CCAs will be accepted only where the same are duly received in hard copy. Applications/Documents received only through email will not be accepted.
  • The nominations of eligible officers along with required documents, duly attested in Hard Copy, must reach by post or special messenger to:
  • Joint Director (CCA), DGPM Hqrs., 5th Floor, Drum Shaped Building, I.P. Estate, New Delhi – 110002 on or before 12th May 2026 (by 5:00 PM).

DGPM CBIC Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

  • The DGPM CBIC Additional Assistant Director Recruitment 2026 is a deputation-based recruitment. Selection will be based on the eligibility criteria as per Recruitment Rules of Additional Assistant Director dated 31.03.2022 of DGPM.
  • The selected officers may be posted to any of the Directorates/Stations throughout India. Applicants may give the option of 05 Directorates in Annexure B(i) and 03 Stations in Annexure B(ii) in order of their preference. However, the options exercised do not guarantee posting at the said Directorate/Station.

How to Apply for DGPM CBIC Recruitment 2026

  • Eligible officers for DGPM CBIC Additional Assistant Director Recruitment 2026 must submit their nominations through proper channel well before the closing date.
  • Step 1 – Check Eligibility: Download and read Annexure-C from www.cbic.gov.in or https://dgpm.gov.in to verify eligibility criteria, educational qualification, and experience requirements.
  • Step 2 – Prepare Application: Fill in the application/nomination form with personal details, service details, cadre information, posting preference (5 Directorates from Annexure B(i) and 3 Stations from Annexure B(ii)), and all required information.
  • Step 3 – Obtain NOC: Obtain No Objection Certificate (NOC) from your employer/department before forwarding the application.
  • Step 4 – Forward Through Proper Channel: Get the nomination forwarded through the concerned CCA (Chief Controller of Accounts) with all required documents duly attested in hard copy.
  • Step 5 – Ensure Hard Copy Reaches on Time: Ensure the complete application in hard copy reaches Joint Director (CCA), DGPM Hqrs., 5th Floor, Drum Shaped Building, I.P. Estate, New Delhi – 110002 on or before 12 May 2026 by 5:00 PM. Applications received after the last date or incomplete in any respect will not be entertained.

Selection Process

Selection will be made through Shortlisting of candidates followed by Interview.

  • Applications will be scrutinized as per eligibility criteria mentioned in the advertisement.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be called for interview (date, time and venue will be informed separately).
  • Candidates have to bear their own travelling cost for attending the interview.
  • Self-attested copies of educational qualifications and experience certificates will be submitted at the time of interview. Original documents will be required for verification.
  • Final selection will be based on performance in the interview and verification of documents.
  • NPS Trust reserves the right to modify the selection procedure, if deemed fit.
  • Mere fulfilling of eligibility criteria does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview.
  • The decision of NPS Trust in all matters relating to eligibility, shortlisting and selection shall be final and binding.
  • Appointment is purely contractual for 3 years (extendable by 2 years subject to outstanding performance). No claim for regular / permanent appointment.

How to Apply

Application Mode: By Email only. No other mode (post, online portal, hand delivery etc.) will be accepted.

Steps to Apply:

  1. Download and fill the prescribed Application Format (Section II of the notification) in legible PDF / type-written format.
  2. Paste recent passport-size photograph and sign across it.
  3. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents (DOB proof, educational certificates & mark sheets, experience certificates, relieving letters, caste / category certificate if applicable, Annexure-A for OBC if required, CV / Resume etc.).
  4. Send the complete application along with supporting documents by email to [email protected].
  5. Mention the exact subject line: “Recruitment of Staff (<Name of the Post & Department>) on Contract Basis”.
  6. Candidates applying for multiple posts must send separate applications for each post.
  7. Applications received after the due date / time or incomplete applications will be summarily rejected.

Note: Only one application per post will be considered (latest application in case of multiple submissions).

General Instructions

  • Cut-off date for determining eligibility (age, qualification, experience) is 28-02-2026.
  • Appointment is purely contractual in nature. Selected candidates shall have no right for permanent absorption in NPS Trust under any circumstances.
  • Initial contract period is 3 years, extendable by 2 years (one year at a time) subject to satisfactory performance.
  • Performance will be reviewed half-yearly. Unsatisfactory performance may lead to termination of contract.
  • Termination of contract can be done by either party by giving 2 months’ notice or payment in lieu thereof.
  • Place of posting is New Delhi (may be transferred anywhere in India as per requirement).
  • No residential accommodation will be provided.
  • Total yearly leave of 30 days (proportionate basis) with conditions mentioned in the notification.
  • Remuneration is fixed monthly gross salary with provision for annual increment based on performance.
  • Proficiency in English and Hindi (reading, writing & speaking) is essential.
  • Candidates working in Government / PSU must submit proper NOC / relieving letter at the time of joining.
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification.
  • Corrigendum / Addendum, if any, will be published only on the official website www.npstrust.org.in.
  • Any dispute arising out of this recruitment shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of Courts at New Delhi only.
  • NPS Trust reserves the right to cancel / modify the recruitment process at any stage without assigning any reason.

Selection Process

Selection will be made through Personal Interview of the provisionally shortlisted candidates.

  • Shortlisting of candidates for Personal Interview shall be done (on or before the date of Interview as per the discretion of management) based on the scrutiny of the applications against the information, declaration and supporting documents provided by the candidate at the time of submission of online application.
  • The mode of selection may be changed, if required, at the discretion of Management.
  • Final selection will be based on performance in the Personal Interview and verification of documents.
  • List of shortlisted candidates, date, time and venue of interview will be uploaded on MECON’s official website and communicated through registered email ID.
  • Candidates must produce all original certificates/documents in support of their claim at the time of interview.
  • Further scrutiny of the application shall be undertaken on the date of Personal Interview. If any claim made in the application is not found substantiated, the candidate will not be allowed to appear for the interview and no TA shall be paid.
  • The decision of MECON in all matters relating to eligibility, shortlisting and selection shall be final and binding.
  • Appointment is on regular basis in the regular scale of pay. Selected candidates will be appointed against regular posts.

How to Apply

Application Mode: Online only through MECON website. No other mode (post, email, offline) will be accepted.

Steps to Apply:

  1. Visit MECON website www.meconlimited.co.in → Careers → Career Opportunities → Click here to apply Online.
  2. Read all instructions carefully before filling the online application.
  3. Fill all required details in the online application form and upload scanned copies of the following documents:
    • Recent passport size colour photograph (jpg/jpeg, max 40 KB)
    • Signature (Blue/Black ink, jpg/jpeg, max 40 KB)
    • Self-attested scanned copies in PDF format (merged into single PDF ≤ 1 MB) of: Matriculation certificate, Graduation/Post-Graduation certificates & mark sheets, Work Experience certificates, Caste/Category certificate (if applicable), Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, etc.
  4. Pay the application fee (if applicable) online through the payment gateway.
  5. Submit the application and take a printout of the online application form for your records.
  6. Candidates applying for multiple posts must submit separate applications for each post.
  7. Applications without fee (where applicable), incomplete or incorrectly filled will be summarily rejected.

  • Age relaxation: 3 years for OBC(NCL), 5 years for SC, additional relaxation for PwD/Ex-Servicemen/J&K domicile as per rules. Upper age limit after relaxation shall not exceed 52 years.
  • Candidates belonging to OBC(NCL) must produce latest OBC(NCL) certificate (not more than 1 year old) and must not belong to Creamy Layer.
  • PwD candidates must upload certificate showing ≥40% disability.
  • Candidates employed in Govt/PSU/Autonomous bodies must produce NOC from present employer at the time of interview or forward application through proper channel.
  • All appointments are subject to medical fitness as per Company’s norms.
  • Place of posting can be anywhere in India as per requirement of the Company.
  • Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidature.
  • Mere submission of application does not guarantee selection.
  • MECON reserves the right to cancel/restrict/enlarge/modify the recruitment process without assigning any reason.

  • All correspondences will be sent only through registered email ID provided in the online application. Candidates are advised to keep their email ID and mobile number active.

The online examination will be conducted only in English. The merit list will be drawn district/region and category wise, with candidates placed according to their aggregate marks in descending order. Selection will be made through Walk-in-Interview only.

Selection Process

Selection will be made through Objective Type Test, Power Point Presentation and Personal Interview.

  • The marks shall be assigned to the following parameters for the final selection:
    • Objective Type Test – 50 marks
    • Personal Interview – 20 marks
    • Power Point presentation for assessing work experience – 30 marks Total – 100 marks
  • The Objective Type Test shall be of 60 Minutes duration comprising of 50 Multiple Choice Questions in the areas of General knowledge (10 marks) and Subject Based (40 marks). Each question carries one mark and there will be no negative marks.
  • Mark lists for the post shall be prepared on the basis of marks secured by candidates in the Objective type test.
  • The minimum pass marks for Objective type test shall be as below:
    • For unreserved post – 50% of Total Marks
    • For SC/ST Candidates – 40% of Total Marks (only for vacancies reserved for SC/ST)
    • For PwBD candidates – 40% of Total Marks
    • For OBC Candidates – 45% of Total Marks (only for vacancies reserved for OBC)
  • Candidates who score minimum prescribed pass marks and above in the Objective test shall be short listed for Power Point Presentation and Personal Interview subject to verification of eligibility requirements (age, educational qualification, reservation and experience etc.).
  • Only those candidates who successfully complete the certificate verification shall be shortlisted to attend the Power Point Presentation and Personal Interview.
  • The Power Point Presentation and Personal Interview shall be held at Udupi Cochin Shipyard Limited (UCSL), Malpe/Kochi or through electronic media or any other location as decided by UCSL.
  • Rank list for the post shall be prepared based on the aggregate marks secured by the candidates in the Objective type test, Experience and Personal Interview. In case same marks secured by more than one candidate, marks scored in the Subject part of the Objective Type Test shall be the basis of determining the order of rank list. In case of a tie thereafter, relative merit shall be decided based on seniority in age.
  • Depending upon the number of online applications received, UCSL reserves the right to scrutinise applications and prepare shortlist of candidates based on meeting eligibility requirements ascertained through the certificates uploaded by the applicants in the online application portal and only such shortlisted candidates may be permitted to attend the selection process.

How to Apply

Application Mode: Online only through UCSL / CSL website. No other mode (post, email, offline) will be accepted.

Steps to Apply:

  1. Visit www.cochinshipyard.in (Career page → UCSL, Malpe) or www.udupicsl.com (Career page).
  2. Go through the User Manual and FAQ published in the link before filling the online application.
  3. The application consists of two phases – One time Registration and submission of application against the post.
  4. Applicants meeting the notified requirements may do the one-time Registration in the SAP Online portal and submit their application.
  5. Upload scanned copies of all certificates towards proof of age, educational qualification, experience, caste, disability etc. and a recent passport size colour photograph.
  6. Pay the application fee (if applicable) using online payment options (Debit card/Credit card/Internet Banking).
  7. Submit the application and ensure that the application status shows “In process” in “My Applications”.
  8. After successful submission, retain a soft copy / printout of the online application containing the unique registration number generated by the system for future reference.
  9. Applicants should not submit more than one application. Application once submitted shall be final.

Application Fee: ₹400/- (Non-refundable + bank charges extra) for UR / OBC / EWS candidates. Exempted for SC / ST / PwBD candidates.

Note: No hard copy of application or documents is required to be sent by post. Applications submitted direct or by any other mode shall not be accepted.

General Instructions

  • Upper age limit is 30 years as on 22-04-2026 (born on or after 23-04-1996). Age relaxation: 3 years for OBC (NCL), 5 years for SC/ST, as per GoI rules for PwBD & Ex-servicemen. Maximum age after all relaxations shall not exceed 45 years.
  • Reservation for SC / ST / OBC (NCL) / EWS / PwBD shall be provided as per Government of India Directives. PwBD candidates can apply only for the identified benchmark disabilities mentioned for Assistant Manager (HR).
  • Period of contract is maximum five years (temporary in nature) subject to project requirements and individual performance. Posting at UCSL-Kochi / Malpe / project sites anywhere in India or abroad.
  • Experience acquired after passing the prescribed qualification and reckoned as on 22-04-2026 only will be considered. All types of training / Apprenticeship with remuneration shall be treated as experience.
  • Only Indian Nationals need to apply. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.
  • No TA/DA shall be paid to candidates for attending the selection process.
  • Mere submission of application or issue of call letter does not confer any right to appointment.
  • Original certificates shall be verified at the time of joining / certificate verification. Candidature is provisional and subject to verification of all documents.
  • UCSL reserves the right to increase / decrease vacancies, cancel the recruitment process or not to fill up any post without assigning any reason.
  • Any dispute arising out of this recruitment shall be subject to the jurisdiction of Courts / Tribunals / Forums at Udupi only.
  • For any clarification, contact [email protected] or landline 0820-2538604.

Personal Interview: Interviews will be conducted on 29-04-2026 from 9:30 AM onwards at the Office of the Dean, ESIC Medical College, Kalaburagi. 50% of total marks is the minimum criteria for eligibility for selection.

Final Selection: Final selection will be based on performance in the personal interview. A waiting list will be prepared and will be valid for a period of 2 months from the date of release of result. Final result will be published on the website at https://www.esic.gov.in/recruitments.

Selection Process

Selection will be made based on the Marks scored in NCTVT (NAC) and Trade Test / Practical Test only, in the order of Merit.

  • Priority & Preference Order:
    1. First Preference: AOCP Trade apprentices of Ordnance Factories and AOCP Trade apprentices from Government/Private Organizations having Government affiliation.
    2. Second Preference: Feeder trade candidates (IMCP, MMCP, PPO, Fitter, Machinist, Turner, etc.) who have experience of working as DBW/CPW on tenure basis and possess certificate of 03 months training (1 month extensive in-house training w.r.t. Safe Handling of explosives, ammunitions, safety norms, Do’s & Don’ts + 2 months On-Job training) from any MIL group of Ordnance Factories.
    3. Third Preference: Feeder trade candidates (IMCP, MMCP, PPO, Fitter, Machinist, Turner, etc.) from Ordnance Factories / Government/Private Organizations having Government affiliation but without 03 months training certificate.
  • Merit List Preparation:
    • Weightage: 80% NCTVT (NAC) Exam + 20% Trade Test / Practical Test.
    • Cut-off percentage for calling candidates for Trade Test will be decided by Ordnance Factory Khamaria based on NAC marks.
    • Merit list prepared category-wise / discipline-wise.
  • Document Verification: Candidates qualifying in NCTVT (NAC) + Trade Test will be called for Document Verification in order of merit. Number of candidates called will be limited to the number of posts notified. Additional candidates will be called in case of rejections.
  • Tie Resolution (in this order):
    1. Ex-Trade Apprentice of AOCP Trade.
    2. Ex-Trade Apprentice of Ordnance Factories.
    3. Higher marks in NAC issued from NCVT.
    4. Date of Birth (elder candidate preferred).

Note: After selection, AOCP candidates (non-Ordance Factory apprentices) and all feeder trade candidates will undergo compulsory 1 month extensive in-house training (and additional 2 months On-Job training for feeder trades) on safe handling of explosives before deployment.

How to Apply

Application Mode: Offline only

Steps to Apply:

  1. Download the Application Form from the official website.
  2. Fill the application form in BLOCK LETTERS only.
  3. Affix one recent passport-size photograph (self-attested) on the form.
  4. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents (see checklist in the notification).
  5. Put two extra photographs (self-attested on the back with Name & Date of Birth).
  6. Place the filled application and enclosures in an envelope superscribed as: “APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF TENURE BASED DBW PERSONNEL ON CONTRACT BASIS”
  7. Send the application by post only to the address given below.

Address: The Chief General Manager, Ordnance Factory Khamaria, District: Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh – 482005

General Instructions

  • Candidates must read the full notification carefully before applying.
  • Mere submission of application does not guarantee issue of call letter for Trade Test.
  • Only shortlisted candidates will be informed through e-mail for Trade Test / Practical Test.
  • Self-attested copies of all educational, NAC, caste, experience certificates etc. must be enclosed.
  • Submission of false / incorrect / incomplete information or bogus documents will lead to disqualification.
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification.
  • No correspondence / enquiry through phone or messenger will be entertained.
  • Ordnance Factory Khamaria will not be responsible for any postal delay or non-receipt of application / call letters.
  • E-mail ID and mobile number must be kept active till completion of the entire recruitment process.
  • SC/ST candidates appearing for Document Verification will be paid 2nd class TA (on production of tickets & caste certificate). SC/ST candidates appearing for Trade Test will travel at their own expense.
  • The engagement is purely on contract basis initially for 1 year, extendable up to maximum 4 years based on requirement and performance.
  • This engagement does not confer any right for regular absorption in the factory.
  • Performance will be evaluated half-yearly / annually. Poor performance may lead to termination after 3 months’ notice period.
  • Personnel will be entitled to EPF, Bonus (if applicable), Risk Allowance, Night Duty Allowance (as per rules), 30 days leave per year, 1 Casual Leave per month etc.
  • They will not be entitled to OT Allowance, LTC, Medical facilities (except emergency), promotions, loans, school fee reimbursement, study leave etc.
  • The employment can be terminated by either party by giving one month’s notice or payment in lieu thereof.
  • Any dispute will be subject to the jurisdiction of courts / tribunals in Jabalpur only.
  • The Competent Authority reserves the right to cancel / modify the recruitment process without assigning any reason.

Selection Process

Selection will be made through Computer Based Test (CBT) followed by Scrutiny/Verification of Documents and Medical Examination.

  • Computer Based Test (CBT):
    • HEMM Operator (Trainee) (all posts): Common paper – 100 Marks, 90 minutes duration.
    • Paramedical Staff & Overseer (Civil): Separate paper for each post – 100 Marks (Section-A: 70 Marks Technical + Section-B: 30 Marks GK/Reasoning/Aptitude), 90 minutes duration.
    • No penalty for wrong answers. No marks for un-attempted questions.
    • Bilingual (English & Hindi). In case of any ambiguity in Hindi, English version will be final.
    • Minimum Qualifying Marks: UR/EWS – 50 marks; SC/ST/ESM/OBC(NCL)/PwBD – 40 marks.
    • Tie-breaking rules prescribed for each category of posts (matric marks, DOB, Section-A marks, alphabetical order etc.).
    • Indicative syllabus given in Annexure-A, B & C of the notification.
  • Document Scrutiny / Verification: Only candidates who qualify CBT as per cut-off will be called for verification of original documents/certificates in order of merit.
  • Medical Examination: Selected candidates must be found medically fit as per CIL Medical Attendance Rules.
  • Final selection is provisional and subject to verification of all documents, character & antecedents, and medical fitness.
  • Result and provisional merit panels will be published on NCL website.

How to Apply

Application Mode: Online only through the official website https://www.nclcil.in (Career > Recruitment > Apply Online). No other mode accepted.

Steps to Apply:

  1. Visit https://www.nclcil.in → Career → Recruitment → Employment Notice/Advertisement for Direct Recruitment → Apply Online.
  2. Register and fill the online application form carefully with all mandatory details.
  3. Upload scanned copies of: Recent passport size photograph, signature, Matriculation certificate, HMV/Transport License (for HEMM posts), relevant Diploma/Degree/Registration certificates, Caste/EWS/PwBD/ESM certificates (if applicable).
  4. Pay the application fee online (if applicable).
  5. Submit the application and take a printout for future reference.
  6. Keep checking the NCL website regularly for updates, admit card, result etc.

  • Candidates must read the complete Employment Notice/Advertisement carefully before applying.
  • Cut-off date for determining eligibility (age, qualification, reservation etc.) is 01-05-2026.
  • Minimum/Essential qualifications acquired through distance learning/part-time shall not be considered.
  • Reservation & relaxation benefits will be given as per Govt. of India rules. Candidates must possess valid certificates in prescribed format.
  • All future correspondence/updates (admit card, result, notices etc.) will be available only on NCL website www.nclcil.in. Candidates are advised to visit the website regularly.
  • Mere issuance of admit card does not guarantee eligibility. Candidature remains provisional till document verification.
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification.
  • Decision of NCL Management in all matters relating to eligibility, selection etc. shall be final and binding.
  • Court of jurisdiction for any dispute will be Hon’ble MP High Court, Jabalpur (M.P.).

RITES Limited Assistant Manager (IT) Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification (All Three Posts – RG/08/26, RG/09/26, RG/10/26): Bachelor's Degree in Computer Engineering/Technology/Computer Science/Degree in Engineering in Computer Applications/Information Technology/Electronics/Electronics & Telecommunications/Electronics & Communication/Electronics & Instrumentation; OR Post Graduate Degree in Electronics/Electronics & Tele Communication/Electronics & Communication/Electronics & Instrumentation/Computer Science/Information Technology/Computer Applications. The degree must be recognised by AICTE/UGC or the concerned regulatory body in India.

UR/EWS category candidates (and SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD candidates applying against unreserved posts) must have First Class degree with minimum 60% marks. Reserved category candidates (SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD) applying against reserved posts must have at least 50% marks.

Minimum Experience: Minimum 2 years of post-qualification experience in one or more areas mentioned in the Job Description of the respective post.

Job Description – Assistant Manager (IT/Network & Security) – RG/08/26: Review and assess HA firewall configuration and policies; evaluate security posture of core network services (DHCP, DNS, VPN); TCP/IP, Ethernet, iSCSI, Fiber Channel Protocol; EDR solution planning and implementation; DPDP Act compliance; cybersecurity improvements; incident analysis and risk mitigation; Wi-Fi and LAN network setup for 100–250 nodes; DLP/EDR/XDR use case creation; Video Conferencing with Central MCU management; SDWAN setup; Firewall Configuration and Network Management.

Job Description – Assistant Manager (IT/Programming) – RG/09/26: Object-Oriented Programming; Software development and system workflow as per SDLC; Relational Database; SAP S/4 HANA, FIORI, ABAP; Problem-solving techniques in the above domains.

Job Description – Assistant Manager (IT/Data Centre) – RG/10/26: Installing, configuring, tuning, and monitoring Windows Server and Linux servers; IIS, DNS, DHCP, Hyper-V configuration; Windows-based scripting for task automation; Remote server administration; VMware vSphere (ESXi and vCenter) and Hyper-V; SAN, backup and storage; batch scripts; infrastructure capacity and performance analysis; regular system maintenance, hardware/software upgrades, physical to virtual migrations; VMware ESXi and Hyper-V virtual machine management; enterprise backup software; hardware and software troubleshooting; rack cabling (power, Cat-6, fiber); power, space, and cooling management; monitoring of network devices, precision air-conditioners, UPS, and Building Management System (BMS) in Data Centre.

Age Limit: Maximum 32 years as on the last date of submission of application (27.04.2026). Age relaxation: SC/ST – 5 years; OBC-NCL – 3 years; Ex-Servicemen – years of service rendered + 3 years; J&K Domicile – 5 years; PwBD – 10 years (in addition to SC/ST/OBC-NCL relaxation as applicable); RITES regular/contract employees – 5 years over and above the upper age limit.

Note: Training period (except on-the-job training), internship, teaching, academic, fellowship, and PhD research experience shall not be counted as part of experience.

RITES Limited Assistant Manager (IT) Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

The RITES Limited Assistant Manager (IT) Recruitment 2026 selection will be conducted in three stages:

Stage 1 – Written Test (60% Weightage): There will be 125 objective type questions carrying 1 mark each for a duration of 2.5 hours. There is no negative marking. Minimum qualifying marks: 50% for UR/EWS (45% for SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD against reserved posts). PwBD candidates are eligible for compensatory time of 50 minutes. The written test will be conducted at 6 cities across India: Delhi/Gurgaon, Kolkata, Bangalore, Mumbai, Bhubaneswar, and Guwahati (all centres except Delhi/Gurgaon are tentative). Candidates must give two centre preferences at the time of online application.

Stage 2 – Document Scrutiny: Based on written test results, documents submitted by shortlisted candidates will be scrutinized by RITES Limited. Shortlisted candidates will be called for interview preceded by verification of original documents.

Stage 3 – Interview (40% Weightage): Candidates will be called for interview in the ratio of 1:6 to the number of vacancies. Weightage: Technical & Professional Proficiency – 30 marks; Personality, Communication & Competency – 10 marks. Minimum qualifying marks in interview: 60% for UR/EWS (50% for SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD against reserved posts). There are no minimum qualifying marks required in the aggregate. Appointment of selected candidates will be subject to medical fitness examination as per RITES Rules and Standards of Medical Fitness.

Written Test Syllabus Summary:

RG/08/26 (IT/Network & Security): Computer Networking Fundamentals; Network Infrastructure Configuration and Management; Network Security and Cybersecurity Practices; Cybersecurity Compliance, Governance and Regulatory Requirements (including DPDP Act); Business Continuity, Disaster Recovery and Incident Management; Collaboration Infrastructure and Enterprise Systems; Basic Computer Science and Engineering concepts.

RG/09/26 (IT/Programming): Programming Fundamentals and OOP Concepts; Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC); Relational Database Management Systems (SQL, ACID properties); Problem Solving and Logical Programming; SAP S/4HANA, ABAP and FIORI; Basic Computer Science and Engineering concepts.

RG/10/26 (IT/Data Centre): Server Installation, Configuration and Administration; Windows Server Services and Automation; Virtualization Technologies (VMware vSphere, Hyper-V); Storage, Backup and Disaster Recovery; Infrastructure Monitoring, Maintenance and Performance Management; Data Centre Infrastructure and Hardware Management; Data Centre Facility Systems Monitoring (BMS, UPS, precision AC); Basic Computer Science and Engineering concepts.

The selection process for MSU Baroda Temporary Teaching Positions follows the framework prescribed under UGC Regulations 2018 and the Gujarat Public Universities Act, 2023 (Statutes 127, 130 and Annexure C).   1. Check Eligibility: Ensure that you meet all the eligibility criteria including educational qualification, age limit, and work experience before applying. No eligibility-related queries will be entertained.

  • No hard copy of application needs to be sent to BPCL.

The examination consists of 100 questions of 100 marks to be completed in 60 minutes (1 hour), divided into two sections: General Awareness & English Comprehension (50 questions, 50 marks, 30 minutes) and Quantitative Aptitude & Reasoning Ability (50 questions, 50 marks, 30 minutes).

There is a penalty for wrong answers -one-fourth (1/4th) of the marks assigned to a question will be deducted for each wrong answer. No penalty applies for unattempted questions. The online examination will be conducted only in English. The merit list will be drawn district/region and category wise, with candidates placed according to their aggregate marks in descending order. In case two or more candidates score equal marks, they will be ranked based on age in descending order (older candidate ranked higher).

A wait list of 50% of notified vacancies will be maintained for one year from the date of result or till the next engagement exercise, whichever is earlier. The Bank reserves the right to conduct any other test or follow any other selection criteria at its discretion.

Selection Process

  • Stage 1 – Combined Pre-Examination (Samyukt Purva Pariksha): All three posts share a common preliminary examination. The pre-exam carries 100 marks.
  • Stage 2 – Main Examination (Mukhya Pariksha): Candidates shortlisted from the Combined Pre-Examination are eligible to appear for the Main Examination of the respective post. The Main Examination carries 400 marks for Maharashtra Group-B (Non-Gazetted) Combined Service Main Examination.
  • Stage 3 – Physical Test (for Police Sub-Inspector only): Physical endurance test of 100 marks is conducted. Qualifying marks: minimum 60 out of 100 (i.e., 60 marks). Candidates scoring below 60 marks are not eligible for interview/further process. Candidates scoring below 60 marks will also not be considered for final selection.
  • The final result will be declared based on the combined merit of the Main Examination marks and Physical Test marks (for Police Sub-Inspector). 
  • The examination type and process for each post shall follow the service entry rules as below:
    • Assistant Section Officer, Group-B (Non-Gazetted) Service Entry Rules 2018.
    • State Tax Inspector (Tax Collector Inspector) Group-B (Non-Gazetted) Service Entry Rules 2021.
    • Police Sub-Inspector, Group-B (Non-Gazetted) Service Entry Rules 1995.
  • The final result process for the Combined Pre-Examination and Main Examination shall be as per the present Examination Scheme / Method published on the Commission's website. 

How to Apply

  • Applications are accepted only through the Commission's Online Application System at https://mpsconline.gov.in. 
  • Step 1 (One): If you have not previously registered on the Commission's Online Application Portal, create a new Profile (Account) and register. If you already have an account, log in and update your profile if necessary.
  • Step 2 (Two): Ensure your account is active and complete KYC verification through the Commission's portal before applying.
  • Step 3 (Three): Complete the KYC (Know Your Customer) process on the Commission's website. The KYC process must be completed as per official Advt. No. ADR-2425/SER.06/2025/MA.TAN. published on 20 June 2025, within the valid period available in the account. The KYC process in the account must be completed independently. 
  • Step 4 (Four): Upload required documents (as applicable) in PDF format within the prescribed file size limits (minimum 50 KB, maximum 500 KB per file)
  • Step 5 (Five): Pay the examination fee online (Credit Card, Debit Card, Net Banking) or offline (Challan at Indian State Bank branch).
  • Step 6 (Six): Select the district examination centre.
  • Step 7 (Seven): As per the Combined Pre-Examination notification, candidates must apply online via the Commission's Computer System for the Maharashtra Group-B (Non-Gazetted) Combined Pre-Examination. 
  • Step 8 (Eight): Based on the Reserved and Unreserved total vacancy count from the Combined Pre-Examination, the number of candidates eligible for the Main Examination will be determined, and a combined merit result of Maharashtra Group-B (Non-Gazetted) service candidates will be declared. 
  • Admit Cards for the examination will be made available on the Commission's Online Application Portal (https://mpsconline.gov.in) 7 days before the examination date. Download the Admit Card and produce it at the examination centre.
  • The Admit Card cannot be issued to candidates themselves; it must be downloaded by the candidate from the Commission portal. 
  • After the Admit Card is made available, the candidate's registered mobile number will receive an SMS notification

General Information / Instructions

  • There are a total of 37 district examination centres across Maharashtra for this examination. (Page 1)
  • Candidates who pass the Combined Pre-Examination and qualify for the Main Examination shall declare the Main Examination date themselves.
  • Applications are accepted only through the Commission's Online Application System. 
  • Application portal: https://mpsconline.gov.in and also available at https://mpsc.gov.in. 
  • Applications will not be considered without payment of the prescribed examination fee
  • KYC verification through the Commission's portal (Advt. No. ADR-2425/SER.06/2025/MA.TAN., dated 20 June 2025) must be completed within the prescribed period before applying. 
  • Candidates who claim Economically Weaker Section (EWS) reservation must upload the income/asset certificate for the year 2025–2026 or 2026–2027 by the last acceptance date (30 April 2026). 
  • Candidates who claim Sports Quota reservation must upload the Sports Certificate (Government Decision dated 01 July 2016) along with the application before the deadline. 
  • Divyang (PWD) candidates must upload valid UDID Card (Universal Identification Card) and relevant disability certificate
  • If the Sports Certificate submitted along with the application is not available, or if the document submitted on or before the prescribed date was not complete/valid, then the Sports Reservation claim shall not be accepted. 
  • Candidates must select a district examination centre at the time of applying. Once a district centre is chosen, it cannot be changed under any circumstances.
  • The following documents must be uploaded by reserved category candidates at the time of applying
    • Proof of Social Category (Caste Certificate) – PDF, Min 50 KB, Max 500 KB
    • Economically Weaker Section certificate for year 2025–2026 or 2026–2027 – PDF
    • Valid Non-Creamy Layer Certificate for year 2025–2026 or 2026–2027 – PDF
    • Proof of eligible PWD/Divyang status – PDF
    • Proof of Ex-Serviceman status – PDF
    • Sports Quota Eligibility proof (for Pre-Exam: Sports Proof of Sports Participation Report or Sports Proof document submission record as applicable) – PDF
    • Proof of Anath (Orphan) Reservation eligibility – PDF
    • Domicile Proof for Backward Class, Divyang, Ex-Serviceman, Anath reservation claim – PDF
  • After appointment, selected candidates must have the following educational/professional qualifications:
    • Where departmental/professional examination is compulsory, the candidate must pass such examination as per departmental norms.
    • Hindi and Marathi language proficiency examinations as per applicable rules. 
    • Computer literacy certificate/proof as per Government Resolution (GR) dated 04 February 2013 (Maharashtra IT GR) and revised GR dated 01 July 2016. 
  • Use of mobile phone or any electronic device at the exam hall, examination venue, physical test, or interview venue is strictly prohibited.
  • Candidates must submit all original documents at the time of document verification; failure to do so will render them ineligible for selection/appointment. 
  • This notification is available on the Commission's website: https://mpsc.gov.in and https://mpsconline.gov.in.

Selection Process

  • The selection process for Central Bank of India Specialist Officers in Risk Management streams consists of an online written examination followed by a personal interview.

  • The final merit will be prepared by giving 70% weightage to the online written test and 30% weightage to the interview, subject to document verification and medical fitness.

  • Only those candidates who qualify the online exam and meet the bank’s cutoff will be called for the interview in a prescribed ratio to the number of vacancies.

How to Apply

Visit official website

  • Go to the official Central Bank of India website: centralbank.bank.in.

  • Open the “Recruitment/ Careers” section and click on the link for “Recruitment Process for Selection of Officers in Specialist Category in Risk Management Streams.”

Open Apply Online link

  • On the recruitment page, click on “Click Here to Apply” / “Apply Online” which redirects to the online registration page (IBPS application link for CBI SO).

  • Read the detailed notification, “How to Apply” and FAQ on the registration page carefully before proceeding.

New registration

  • Click on “New Registration” and enter basic details (name, contact number, email ID, etc.) to generate a Registration Number and Password.

  • Note down the Registration Number and Password for future login and form completion.

Fill online application form

  • Log in using Registration Number and Password and select the relevant post/scale (Analytics & Model Risk, Asset Liability Management, Digital Risk Management, Enterprise Risk, Market Risk in Scale IV/III/II as applicable).

  • Fill personal details, category, domicile, address, qualification (B.Sc/B.Tech/BE/MBA/PGDM etc.) and post-qualification experience in Risk/IT/ALM/Digital Risk as per eligibility.

  • Ensure all experience details (years, organisation, role) match what is required for the chosen scale and stream.

Upload required documents

  • Upload recent passport-size photograph, signature, left thumb impression and handwritten declaration in the prescribed dimensions and file size, as per the instructions in the notification.

  • Upload supporting documents (if asked at application stage) like educational certificates, experience certificates and category certificates in the specified format.

Pay application fee

  • Pay the application fee online: ₹175/- (intimation charges) for SC/ST/PwBD/Women candidates and ₹850/- (application fee + intimation charges) for all other candidates, through debit card/credit card/net banking/UPI.

  • After successful payment, verify that the fee status shows as “paid” and proceed to final submit. Applications without successful fee payment (where applicable) will be treated as incomplete.

Final submission and print

  • Review all details carefully; edit if required before final submission, as no changes are allowed after final submit.

  • Click on “Final Submit” and generate your application form.

  • Download and take a printout of the e-receipt and submitted application form for future reference, online exam and interview/document verification stages.

General Instructions for Candidates

  • Apply online only; no other mode of application will be accepted.

  • Ensure you fall within the required age limits for Scale IV (20–45 years) and Scale III/II (20–35 years) with applicable relaxations as per Government/Bank rules.

  • Enter details exactly as per your certificates; any mismatch or false information may lead to rejection at any stage of the recruitment process.

  • Keep the registered mobile number and email ID active; all communication regarding exam date, admit card, interview schedule, etc., will be sent on these only.

  • Candidates are advised to complete the application process well before 30-04-2026 to avoid last-minute technical issues.

CNP Nashik SPMCIL Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

The selection process for the above-mentioned posts will be based mainly on an Online Examination. DGPM CBIC Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

  • Additional Assistant Director: The post is to be filled on deputation basis. The eligibility criteria including educational qualification, experience, and other conditions are detailed in Annexure-C, available on the CBIC website (www.cbic.gov.in) and DGPM website (https://dgpm.gov.in).
  • The Directorate General of Performance Management is the cadre control authority in respect of Group 'B' and 'C' cadres including the post of Additional Assistant Director in various Directorates under CBIC.
  • These Directorates deal with functions such as investigations into cases of evasion of duties/taxes, human resource development, infrastructure, audit, inspections, legal and appellate matters, systems and data management, and data analysis.
  • Candidates whose applications are forwarded by the concerned Ministry/Department/Organization once received in DGPM will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature subsequently.

DGPM CBIC Recruitment 2026 Salary

  • Selected officers under DGPM CBIC Additional Assistant Director Recruitment 2026 will be placed at Pay Matrix Level-8 (Rs. 47,600–1,51,100) on deputation basis.
  • After completion of four years of regular service in Level-8, officers will be placed at Level-9 (Rs. 53,100–1,67,800) in the pay matrix.

DGPM CBIC Recruitment 2026 Application Process

  • The nomination/application process for DGPM CBIC Additional Assistant Director Recruitment 2026 is through offline/hard copy mode only via the proper channel. Eligible officers must get their nominations forwarded by their concerned CCAs (Chief Controllers of Accounts) along with NOC and all required documents.
  • Applications/Documents received through e-Office of concerned CCAs will be accepted only where the same are duly received in hard copy. Applications/Documents received only through email will not be accepted.
  • The nominations of eligible officers along with required documents, duly attested in Hard Copy, must reach by post or special messenger to:
  • Joint Director (CCA), DGPM Hqrs., 5th Floor, Drum Shaped Building, I.P. Estate, New Delhi – 110002 on or before 12th May 2026 (by 5:00 PM).

DGPM CBIC Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

  • The DGPM CBIC Additional Assistant Director Recruitment 2026 is a deputation-based recruitment. Selection will be based on the eligibility criteria as per Recruitment Rules of Additional Assistant Director dated 31.03.2022 of DGPM.
  • The selected officers may be posted to any of the Directorates/Stations throughout India. Applicants may give the option of 05 Directorates in Annexure B(i) and 03 Stations in Annexure B(ii) in order of their preference. However, the options exercised do not guarantee posting at the said Directorate/Station.

How to Apply for DGPM CBIC Recruitment 2026

  • Eligible officers for DGPM CBIC Additional Assistant Director Recruitment 2026 must submit their nominations through proper channel well before the closing date.
  • Step 1 – Check Eligibility: Download and read Annexure-C from www.cbic.gov.in or https://dgpm.gov.in to verify eligibility criteria, educational qualification, and experience requirements.
  • Step 2 – Prepare Application: Fill in the application/nomination form with personal details, service details, cadre information, posting preference (5 Directorates from Annexure B(i) and 3 Stations from Annexure B(ii)), and all required information.
  • Step 3 – Obtain NOC: Obtain No Objection Certificate (NOC) from your employer/department before forwarding the application.
  • Step 4 – Forward Through Proper Channel: Get the nomination forwarded through the concerned CCA (Chief Controller of Accounts) with all required documents duly attested in hard copy.
  • Step 5 – Ensure Hard Copy Reaches on Time: Ensure the complete application in hard copy reaches Joint Director (CCA), DGPM Hqrs., 5th Floor, Drum Shaped Building, I.P. Estate, New Delhi – 110002 on or before 12 May 2026 by 5:00 PM. Applications received after the last date or incomplete in any respect will not be entertained.

BARC RA Fellowship Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

  • Research Associate (Ph.D. Projects): Candidates must possess a Ph.D. in the relevant discipline as specified for each Research Project - including Chemical Sciences, Physical Sciences, Polymer Science, Physics, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Chemical Engineering, Biosciences, Agriculture, Biotechnology, Molecular Biology, Materials Science and related fields.
  • Research Associate (Project No. 21 - Muon Tomography): Candidates must have B.Tech/B.E./M.Tech/M.E. in Electronics, Electronics & Telecommunication, Computer Science, Information Technology or Electronics & Computer Engineering with one year of relevant experience preferred.
  • Experience: Relevant post-Ph.D. research experience in the specific field as detailed against each project is desirable/preferred. Candidates who have submitted their Ph.D. thesis and are awaiting evaluation are not eligible.
  • Age Limit: No specific age limit mentioned; candidates should meet BARC/DST fellowship norms applicable for Research Associates.

BARC RA Fellowship Recruitment 2026 - Fellowship Amount

  • Selected candidates under BARC RA Fellowship Recruitment 2026 will be placed at one of three fellowship levels - RA-I, RA-II or RA-III - based on qualifications, experience and performance in the selection interview.
  • Fellowship Details: RA-I carries Rs. 58,000/- per month plus Contingency Grant of Rs. 20,000/- per annum plus HRA as applicable. RA-II and RA-III carry higher fellowship amounts plus Contingency Grant and HRA as per BARC norms. The level will be decided by the interview committee based on quality of Ph.D. thesis, post-Ph.D. research experience, publications/products and performance in interview.
  • Note: Hostel accommodation will not be provided to Research Associates.
  • RA-I: 58,000/- p.m. plus Contingency Grant of 60,000/- per annum plus HRA as applicable.
  • RA-II : 61,000/- p.m. plus Contingency Grant of 60,000/- per annum plus HRA as applicable.
  • RA-III : 67,000/- p.m. plus Contingency Grant of 60,000/- per annum plus HRA as applicable.

BARC RA Fellowship Recruitment 2026 Application Fees

  • As per the BARC RA Fellowship Recruitment 2026 advertisement, no application fee is prescribed for candidates applying for Research Associate posts.
  • Fee Status: Candidates can prepare and submit their BARC RA online application form 2026 by post to BARC Mumbai without paying any examination or application fee.

BARC RA Fellowship Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

  • The BARC Research Associate Fellowship Recruitment 2026 selection will be conducted through screening of applications followed by a personal interview - no written exam.
  • Stage 1 - Screening: Applications received will be subject to screening based on qualifications, experience and relevance to the research project. Only screened-in candidates will be called for interview. All information related to selection will be made available on www.barc.gov.in.
  • Stage 2 - Interview: Shortlisted candidates will be interviewed. The RA fellowship level (RA-I / RA-II / RA-III) will be decided by the interview committee based on: (i) quality of Ph.D. thesis, (ii) post-Ph.D. research experience as evidenced from publications and/or products/processes developed, and (iii) performance in the selection interview. Candidates must bring a copy of the application and a valid photo identity card (Aadhaar, Passport, Driving License, College ID or Voter ID) and all original documents at the time of interview.

How to Apply for BARC RA Fellowship Recruitment 2026

  • Eligible candidates for BARC Research Associate Fellowship Recruitment 2026 must submit their application by post within the last date of 24 Apr 2026.
  • Step 1 - Download Application Format: Download the prescribed application form from the official BARC website www.barc.gov.in (Advertisement No. 3/2026(R-V)).
  • Step 2 - Fill Application Form: Fill in personal details, date of birth, nationality, category (SC/ST/OBC), correspondence address, contact details, educational qualifications from SSC onwards, Ph.D. topic details, work experience, publications and conference participation carefully. Mention the Research Project Number you are applying for.
  • Step 3 - Affix Photograph: Affix a recent passport-size photograph in the space provided on the application form.
  • Step 4 - Attach Documents: Attach one set of photocopies of all mark-sheets and degree certificates from SSC to Ph.D., PAN/Aadhaar Card, Caste Certificate (if applicable), work experience certificates, publications and any other relevant documents as per the checklist in the application form.
  • Step 5 - Dispatch by Post: Review all entries, superscribe the envelope with the Research Project Number and send by post to Deputy Establishment Officer, Recruitment-V, Central Complex, BARC, Trombay, Mumbai - 400085, so as to reach by 24 Apr 2026. Apply separately for each Research Project with a separate set of documents. Keep a copy safely for future reference.
